我们在第 3.1 节看到，存在一个求解三次方程的公式，它于 1545 年由卡尔达诺首次发表。在同一本书中，卡尔达诺还发表了求解四次方程的公式。两个公式都用方程的系数、有理运算 +,−,×,÷ 以及平方根和立方根来表示解。这激起了人们对高次方程也有类似解法的希望——即当时所称的根式解（n 次根）。这一希望最终在 1820 年代被阿贝尔和伽罗瓦打破，他们证明了五次及更高次的方程不存在这样的公式。

We saw in Section 3.1 that there is a formula for solving cubic equations, first published by Cardano in 1545. In the same book Cardano also published a formula for solving quartic (fourth-degree) equations. Both formulas express the solution in terms of the coefficients of the equation, the rational operations +,−,×,÷ and square and cube roots. This raised the hope of similar solutions for higher-degree equations – solutions by radicals (n th roots), as they were called. This hope was eventually dashed in the 1820s by Abel and Galois, who showed that no such formulas exist for equations of fifth degree and higher.

但在根式解被排除之前，高斯就已经提出了处理多项式方程的另一种途径：满足于证明解的存在性，而不是用公式求出它。约在 1800 年，高斯以这种风格给出了几个证明，其关键要素是诉诸连续函数的性质。

But before solution by radicals was ruled out, Gauss had already suggested a different approach to polynomial equations: be content to prove existence of a solution rather finding it in a formula. Around 1800, Gauss gave several proofs in this style, the key ingredient of which was appeal to properties of continuous functions.

存在性证明所带来的简化，可以用一个三次方程的情形来说明，例如 x3−x+2=0。只要看一下 y=x3−x+2 的图像（图 15），就立即清楚为什么对某个 x 值有 x3−x+2=0。图像连续地从负值（当 x 为很大的负值时）过渡到正值（当 x 为很大的正值时），因此它必在某处取值 0。

The simplification made possible by an existence proof can be illustrated in the case of a cubic equation, say x3−x+2=0. If one inspects the graph of y=x3−x+2 (Figure 15) then it is immediately clear why x3−x+2=0 for some value of x. The graph passes continuously from negative values (for large negative values of x) to positive values (for large positive values of x), and hence it somewhere takes the value 0.

同样的论证适用于任何奇数次多项式。1816 年，高斯借助一些巧妙的代数把它推广到任意次数的多项式：这种代数把 2n 次方程的求解化归为一个二次方程（其解可能是复数）和一个 n 次方程的求解。通过反复把次数减半，最终会得到一个奇数次方程，因此解存在。这样，高斯（1816）的论证就把任何多项式方程的解的存在性——即如今所称的代数基本定理——化归为一些代数，再加上关于连续函数的一个看似显然的事实。

The same argument applies to any polynomial of odd degree. In 1816 Gauss extended it to polynomials of any degree by some ingenious algebra that reduces the solution of an equation of degree 2n to the solution of a quadratic (where the solution may be complex) and an equation of degree n. By repeatedly halving the degree one reaches an equation of odd degree, and hence a solution exists. Thus Gauss’s (1816) argument reduces the existence of solutions of any polynomial equation – the fundamental theorem of algebra as it is now called – to some algebra plus a seemingly obvious fact about continuous functions.

高斯乐于假定有关连续性的事实，但事实上，他正站在一个新的实分析世界的边缘；在这个世界里，连续函数的本性与性质成为关注的焦点。

Gauss was happy to assume facts about continuity, but in fact he stood on the brink of a new world of real analysis, in which the nature and properties of continuous functions were the focus of attention.

5.2 介值定理

5.2 The Intermediate Value Theorem

值得注意的是，高斯（1816）的证明立即受到了关注，其中关于连续函数的关键思想被波尔查诺（1817）表述为一条定理。这就是我们今天所说的介值定理。

Remarkably, Gauss’s (1816) proof was immediately noticed, and its crucial idea about continuous functions formulated as a theorem by Bolzano (1817). This is what we now call the intermediate value theorem.

介值定理。如果 f 是一个对满足 a≤x≤b 的 x 有定义的连续函数，并且 f(a)<0、f(b)>0，那么对 a 与 b 之间的某个 c，有 f(c)=0。

Intermediate Value Theorem. If f is a continuous function, defined for x with a≤x≤b, and if f(a)<0 and f(b)>0, then f(c)=0 for some c between a and b.

为了陈述这条定理，波尔查诺必须定义“连续”是什么意思，而他得出的本质上就是现代的定义：f 在 x 处连续，是指对每个 ε>0，都存在 δ>0，使得 |x−x′|<δ⇒|f(x)−f(x′)|<ε。（不那么正式地说：只要选取足够接近 x 的 x′，就能使 f(x′) 任意接近 f(x)。）于是，若对每个满足 a≤x≤b 的 x，f 都在 x 处连续，那么 f 就简单地称为在 x 从 a 到 b 上连续。

To state the theorem, Bolzano had to define what ‘continuous’ means, and he came up with essentially the modern definition: f is continuous at x if, for each ε>0 there is a δ>0 such that |x−x′|<δ⇒|f(x)−f(x′)|<ε. (Speaking less formally: we can make f(x′) as close as we please to f(x) by choosing x′ sufficiently close to x.) Then f is simply continuous for x from a to b if f is continuous at x whenever a≤x≤b.

即使以非正式的方式陈述，也并不清楚这个定义是否表达了人们希望“连续”所具有的含义。人们更愿意说“y=f(x) 的图像是不间断的”，或诸如此类的话——事实上，就是某种类似介值定理的说法。波尔查诺非凡的洞察力使他得出了这样一个定义：它使得“不间断”这一模糊的整体性质，可以从“在一点处连续”这一精确的局部性质推出。

Even when stated informally, it is not clear that this definition states what one wants ‘continuous’ to mean. One would prefer to say ‘the graph of y=f(x) is unbroken’, or something like that – in fact, something like the intermediate value theorem. Bolzano’s extraordinary insight led him to a definition that allows the vague global property of unbrokenness to follow from the precise local property of continuity at a point.

波尔查诺无疑拥有证明介值定理所需的正确的连续性定义，但他的证明依赖于数的一条未经证明的性质。这就是最小上界原理，它断言任何有界的数集都有最小上界。波尔查诺只能为这一原理给出模糊的论证，因为他对数轴只有一个模糊的、几何的概念。在数的概念以纯算术的方式得到定义之前，不可能再前进一步。

Bolzano certainly had the right definition of continuity to prove the intermediate value theorem, but his proof depended on an unproved property of numbers. This was the least upper bound principle, stating that any bounded set of numbers has a least upper bound. Bolzano could give only vague justification for this principle, because he had only a vague, geometric, conception of the number line. It was not possible to go further until the number concept had been defined in purely arithmetic fashion.

5.3 实数的定义

5.3 Definition of Real Numbers

波尔查诺的工作很少受到关注；在他之后几十年，戴德金也对微积分中的直觉论证感到类似的不满。他在 1872 年的小册子《连续性与无理数》中写道：

Some decades after Bolzano, whose work received little attention, Dedekind experienced a similar dissatisfaction with intuitive arguments in calculus. In his 1872 booklet Continuity and Irrational Numbers, he wrote,

作为苏黎世理工学院的教授，我第一次不得不讲授微分学的基础，并且比以往任何时候都更强烈地感到算术缺乏一个真正科学的基础。在讨论一个变量趋近于一个固定极限值的概念时，特别是在证明“一个不断增长但不超过一切界限的量必定趋近于一个极限值”这一定理时，我求助于几何论证……更仔细的研究使我确信，这条定理或任何与之等价的定理，在某种意义上都可以被看作无穷小分析的充分基础。剩下的只是要在算术的基本要素中发现它的真正起源，从而同时获得连续性本质的一个真正的定义。我在 1858 年 11 月 24 日成功了。
As professor in the Polytechnic School in Zürich I found myself for the first time obliged to lecture on the elements of the differential calculus and felt more keenly than ever before the lack of a really scientific foundation for arithmetic. In discussing the notion of the approach of a variable magnitude to a fixed limiting value, and especially in proving the theorem that a magnitude which grows continually, but not beyond all limits, must certainly approach a limiting value, I had recourse to geometric arguments … a more careful investigation convinced me that this theorem, or any one equivalent to it, can be regarded in some way as a sufficient basis for infinitesimal analysis. It then only remained to discover its true origin in the elements of arithmetic and thus at the same time to secure a real definition of the essence of continuity. I succeeded Nov. 24, 1858.

戴德金所说的“连续性”，就是我们今天所称的实数的连通性；非正式地说，就是实数“没有空隙”。在这方面，它们与有理数形成对比，后者在 2 的位置以及许多其他位置都有空隙。

By ‘continuity’, Dedekind means what we now call the connectedness of the real numbers; informally, that they have ‘no gaps’. In this respect they contrast with the rational numbers, which have a gap at the position of 2 and many other places.

那么，有理数中的空隙究竟是什么？它是把有理数划分为两个集合 L 和 U，使得 U 的每个元素都大于 L 的每个元素；L 没有最大元素，U 也没有最小元素。例如，2 处的空隙，其上集 U 由所有平方大于 2 的正有理数组成，下集 L 由其余所有有理数组成。由于 2 不是有理数，L 没有最大元素，U 也没有最小元素。一般地，每个无理数都对应于有理数中的一个空隙，戴德金称之为分割。

Now what, precisely, is a gap in the rational numbers? It is a partition of the rational numbers into two sets L and U, such that each member of U is greater than each member of L; L has no greatest member, and U has no least member. The gap at 2, for example, has upper set U consisting of all positive rationals with square greater than 2, and lower set L consisting of all the remaining rational numbers. Since 2 is not rational, L has no greatest member and U has no least. In general, each irrational corresponds to a gap in the rational numbers, which Dedekind called a cut.

这一思想显然类似于欧几里得《几何原本》第五卷对无理量的处理（第 2.4 节），只不过无穷集合不再被回避。戴德金大胆而简单的思想，是把无穷集合用作数学对象。于是，“有理数中的空隙”就是一个有意义的数学对象——一对具有上述性质的集合 L,U——我们可以用它来定义一个无理数。这样，有理数与无理数合在一起就构成了一个没有空隙的数系，我们今天称之为实数系 ℝ。

This idea is clearly similar to the treatment of irrational quantities in Book V of Euclid’s Elements (Section 2.4) except that infinite sets are no longer avoided. Dedekind’s bold but simple idea was to use infinite sets as mathematical objects. A ‘gap in the rationals’ is then a meaningful mathematical object – a pair of sets L,U with the above properties – which we can take to define an irrational number. Thus the rationals and irrationals together form a number system without gaps, which we now call the real number system ℝ.

通过以这种方式把实数建立在有理数之上，戴德金发现，实数的连通性在“算术的基本要素中”有其“真正的起源”。此外，很容易证明有理数的代数性质（例如 a+b=b+a 和 ab=ba）以自然的方式延续到实数上。而借助集合概念，戴德金发现同样容易证明波尔查诺的最小上界原理，从而为实分析提供了算术基础。

By basing the real numbers on rational numbers in this way, Dedekind had found their connectedness had its ‘true origin in the elements of arithmetic’. Moreover, it is easy to show that the algebraic properties of the rational numbers (such as a+b=b+a and ab=ba) carry over to the real numbers in a natural way. And by using the set concept, Dedekind found it equally easy to prove Bolzano’s least upper bound principle, and hence provide an arithmetic foundation for real analysis.

为了证明最小上界原理，我们首先用一个有上界且“向下封闭”的有理数集 Lx 来表示每个实数 x；所谓向下封闭，是指具有如下性质：若 r∈Lx 且 s<r，则 s∈Lx。对于无理数 x，Lx 就是定义 x 的那对 L,U 中的 L；对于有理数 x，我们取 Lx 为所有 ≤x 的有理数之集。这种表示具有一个便利的性质：实数的序对应于集合的包含关系，即 x≤y 当且仅当 Lx⊆Ly。

To prove the least upper bound principle, we first represent each real number x by a set Lx of rational numbers which is bounded above and ‘closed downward’: that is, with the property that if r∈Lx and s<r then s<Lx. For an irrational number x, Lx is the L in the pair L,U that defines x; for a rational number x we take Lx to be the set of rationals ≤x. This representation has the convenient property that the ordering of real numbers corresponds to set containment: namely, x≤y if and only if Lx⊆Ly.

于是，如果我们有一个有界的实数集 x，那么集合 Lx 也都有界，从而它们的并 L 也有界。由此可知，由集合 L 所确定的实数 l 就是这些数 x 的最小上界。

Then if we have a bounded set of real numbers x, the sets Lx are also bounded, and hence so is their union L. It follows that the real number l determined by the set L is the least upper bound of the numbers x.

（注：PDF 原文此处印作“then s < Lx”，应为排版错误；按上下文中文译为 s ∈ Lx；英文保留原文。）

(Note: the PDF prints “then s < Lx” here, evidently a typesetting error; it is the sense required is s ∈ Lx. The English is kept as printed.)

5.4 反直觉的曲线

5.4 Counter-intuitive Curves

通过把几何直觉从分析的基础中驱逐出去，波尔查诺和戴德金使反直觉的对象得以被研究和精确分析。对一些数学家来说，这是令人震惊的发展，他们“怀着恐惧与厌恶，背离了这场可怕的瘟疫”（转述埃尔米特 1893 年致斯蒂尔吉斯的一封信）。但对另一些人来说，这是受欢迎的，它不仅提供了严格性，还提供了一种真正磨砺直觉、看到朴素直觉所看不到的东西的途径。

By banishing geometric intuition from the foundations of analysis, Bolzano and Dedekind made it possible for counter-intuitive objects to be studied and accurately analysed. For some mathematicians, this was shocking development, and they ‘turned away in horror and disgust from this awful plague’ (to paraphrase a letter from Hermite to Stieltjes in 1893). But for others it was welcome, offering not only rigor but a way to actually sharpen one’s intuition and see things that naive intuition could not.

旧的无穷小形式体系不够锐利，因为它暗示：连续函数 y=f(x) 就是 x 的无穷小变化 dx 导致 y 的无穷小变化 dy 的函数。于是这种记号使我们相信 dy/dx 存在；也就是说，连续函数 y=f(x) 的图像在每一点都有斜率。事实上，牛顿和其他微积分的奠基者就是这样相信的。但他们错了：波尔查诺和其他十九世纪数学家发现，存在在任何一点都没有切线的连续曲线，以及具有其他反直觉性质的曲线。

The old formalism of infinitesimals was not sharp enough, because it suggests that a continuous function y=f(x) is one for which an infinitesimal change dx in x produces an infinitesimal change dy in y. The notation then leads us to believe that dy/dx exists; that is, the graph of a continuous y=f(x) has a slope at each point. Indeed, Newton and other founders of calculus believed as much. But they were wrong: Bolzano and other nineteenth-century mathematicians discovered that there are continuous curves with no tangent at any point, and other counter-intuitive properties.

冯·科赫（1904）给出了一个没有切线的曲线的可爱例子，它作为一列折线的极限而得到。该序列的前五条折线如图 16 所示。

A lovely example of a curve without tangents, obtained as the limit of the sequence of polygonal curves, was given by von Koch (1904). The first five polygons of the sequence are shown in Figure 16.

我认为，这个序列有一条连续的极限曲线，这是“直观的”。但同样可以“看出”它没有切线。从它的构造可以清楚地看到，极限曲线可以分成四段（对应于第二幅图中的四条线段），每一段放大 3 倍后都与整条曲线一模一样。但如果曲线在任一点有切线，那么该点的邻域在放大之下应当变得更直。

It is, I think, ‘intuitive’ that this sequence has a continuous limit curve. But it can also be ‘seen’ that it has no tangents. It is clear from its construction that the limit curve can be divided into four pieces (corresponding to the four line segments in the second picture), each of which looks exactly the same as the whole curve when magnified by 3. But if the curve had a tangent at any point, the neighbourhood of that point would become straighter under magnification.

在维连金（1995）的《寻找无穷》一书中，可以找到许多其他可以说服直觉去把握的奇异对象的例子。它们表明，我们的几何直觉所能做的，远比十九世纪以前的数学家所认为的多。尽管如此，十九世纪还出现了对直觉的其他挑战，我们将在下一节看到。

Many other examples of bizarre objects that intuition can be persuaded to grasp may be found in the book In Search of Infinity by Vilenkin (1995). They show that our geometric intuition is capable of much more than mathematicians thought, before the nineteenth century. Nevertheless, other challenges to intuition arose in the nineteenth century, as we will see in the next section.

5.5 哲学问题

5.5 Philosophical Issues

介值定理的证明是一个无穷构造，它通过反复把 c 应在其中的区间减半，来捕捉使 f(c)=0 的点 c。它与经典的穷竭法证明（假定最小上界存在）并没有太大不同，只不过它依赖于“给定”函数 f。在波尔查诺的时代，这意味着什么并不清楚，这就引起了一种怀疑：介值定理纯粹是一个存在性定理，其中声称对象 c 存在，却没有构造出它。

The proof of the intermediate value theorem is an infinite construction that captures the point c where f(c)=0 by repeatedly halving the interval in which c ought to lie. It is not so different from a classical proof by exhaustion (assuming the existence of least upper bounds), except that it depends on being ‘given’ the function f. In Bolzano’s time, it was not clear what this meant, which created the suspicion that the intermediate value theorem is purely an existence theorem, where the object c is claimed to exist but not constructed.

实际上，当 f 是多项式时（如在代数基本定理中），构造 c 不成问题。但关于连续函数的更多存在性定理接踵而至，它们在十九世纪后期成为与“构造主义者”争论的焦点。无论如何，波尔查诺证明中更成问题的部分，是如何定义实数，以保证最小上界性质以及它们的代数结构：简言之，就是直线的算术化。正如我们将在接下来的两节中看到的，这引发了一连串始料未及的哲学问题。

Actually, construction of c is not a problem when f is a polynomial, as in the fundamental theorem of algebra. But more existence theorems about continuous functions were to follow, and they became a bone of contention with ‘constructivists’ later in the nineteenth century. In any case, the more problematic part of Bolzano’s proof is defining the real numbers so as to guarantee the least upper bound property and also their algebraic structure: in short, the arithmetization of the line. This led to an eruption of unforeseen philosophical problems, as we will see in the next two sections.

但紧随波尔查诺和戴德金之后，就已经出现了若干问题。

But, in the immediate wake of Bolzano and Dedekind, there were already several issues.

直觉与逻辑。与“代数是离散的”这一直觉相反，代数基本定理似乎涉及连续性。而关于连续曲线（以及一般而言关于微积分）的直觉，需要一个更深的基础，即实数的算术理论。

Intuition and logic. Contrary to the intuition that algebra is discrete, the fundamental theorem of algebra seems to involve continuity. And the intuition about continuous curves (and calculus in general) demands a deeper foundation, in an arithmetic theory of real numbers.

意义与存在。在不给出所声称存在的对象的公式的情况下证明其存在，这意味着什么？实数究竟是什么？是什么解释了它们的完备性，即它们在各种无穷运算下的封闭性？（戴德金的定义给出了一个答案；还有其他选择吗？）

Meaning and existence. What does it mean to prove existence, without giving a formula for the object claimed to exist? What precisely are the real numbers, and what explains their completeness; that is, their closure under various infinite operations? (Dedekind’s definition gives one answer; are there alternatives?)

离散与连续。特别是，我们如何能够——在避开无穷小这种可疑手段的前提下——最好地用离散（自然数）来定义连续（实数）？

Discrete and continuous. In particular, how best can we – avoiding the dubious means of infinitesimals – define the continuous (real numbers) in terms of the discrete (natural numbers)?

6 从非欧几何到算术

6 From Non-Euclidean Geometry to Arithmetic

预览

PREVIEW

与此同时，欧几里得在另一方面也被发现有所欠缺。几百年甚至几千年来，平行公理一直被视为欧几里得体系上一个不必要的瑕疵。许多数学家曾试图从欧几里得的其他公理证明它，但到 1800 年，希望已日渐渺茫。一些人开始考虑此前不可想象的东西：一种平行公理不成立的非欧几何。

Meanwhile, Euclid had been found wanting in another respect. For hundreds, if not thousands, of years the parallel axiom had been considered an unnecessary blemish on Euclid’s system. Many mathematicians had tried to prove it from Euclid’s other axioms, but by 1800 hopes were fading. Some began to consider the previously unthinkable: a non-Euclidean geometry in which the parallel axiom was false.

这种奇异而美妙的几何起初只是在假设性地被探索。但贝尔特拉米（1868）找到了它的模型，表明非欧几何与欧氏几何同样一致。随着这一发现，欧氏几何失去了它在数学基础中（以及作为物理空间的假定几何）的特权地位。

This strange but wonderful geometry was at first explored only hypothetically. But Beltrami (1868) found models of it, showing that non-Euclidean geometry is just as consistent as Euclidean. With this discovery, Euclidean geometry lost its privileged position at the foundation of mathematics (and as the presumed geometry of physical space).

是时候建立数学的新基础了，而算术已准备好取代几何的位置。戴德金找到了实数直线 ℝ 的算术定义，在此之上可以建立几何与分析的新基础：格拉斯曼的实向量空间。

It was time to build a new foundation of mathematics, and arithmetic was ready to take the place of geometry. Dedekind had found an arithmetic definition of the real number line ℝ, on which it was possible to build a new foundation of geometry and analysis: the real vector spaces of Grassmann.

6.1 平行公理

6.1 The Parallel Axiom

正如我们在上一节所见，十九世纪上半叶的数学家在微观层面上对几何直觉失去了信心，因为在那里它未能把握直线的局部性质。大约在同一时期，人们在宏观层面上也对几何直觉失去了信心，因为在那里它未能把握直线的整体性质——特别是平行线的行为。

As we saw in the previous section, mathematicians in the first half of the nineteenth century lost faith in geometric intuition at the micro level, where it failed to grasp the local nature of the line. During roughly the same time period there was also a loss of faith in geometric intuition at the macro level, where it failed to grasp the global nature of lines – in particular, the behaviour of parallels.

第 1.4 节已经指出问题所在：在于欧几里得的平行公理，它隐含地断言了平行线的存在性与唯一性。平行公理是一条非常有用的公理，被用于证明欧几里得几何的许多标志性定理，例如勾股定理。事实上，就连正方形的存在也依赖于平行公理，因为需要唯一的平行线来证明三角形的内角和为 π，进而证明四边形的内角和为 2π。平行公理的另一个重要推论（与我们的经验非常吻合）是：任何大小的图形都可以具有相同的形状。

Section 1.4 showed where the problem lies: in Euclid’s parallel axiom, which implicitly claims the existence and uniqueness of parallels. The parallel axiom was a very useful axiom, used in the proof of many signature theorems of Euclid’s geometry, such as the Pythagorean theorem. In fact, even the existence of squares depends on the parallel axiom, because unique parallels are needed to prove that the angle sum of a triangle is π, and hence that the angle sum of a quadrilateral is 2π. Another important consequence of the parallel axiom, which chimes well with our experience, is that figures of any size can have the same shape.

对许多人来说，这类定理比平行公理本身更容易接受，人们也找到了它们蕴涵平行公理的证明。最终的希望是：欧几里得的其他公理——它们无疑比平行公理更可信——或许能被发现蕴涵平行公理，这样欧几里得体系上的这个“瑕疵”就可以被去除。欧几里得的其他公理所说的都是无可争议的事情，例如：过任意两点有唯一一条直线；直线是无限的；如果两个三角形有两边及其夹角对应相等，那么它们的所有边和所有角都对应相等。

To many, theorems like these were more acceptable than the parallel axiom itself, and proofs that they imply the parallel axiom were found. The ultimate hope was that Euclid’s other axioms – which are certainly more plausible than the parallel axiom – might be found to imply the parallel axiom, so that this ‘blemish’ on Euclid could be removed. Euclid’s other axioms say uncontroversial things like: there is a unique line through any two points, lines are infinite, and if two triangles agree in two sides and the included angle then they agree in all sides and all angles.

人们希望，如果采用其他公理，再加上“平行线不唯一”这条公理，就会发现矛盾。第一个追寻这个难以捉摸的矛盾的人是萨凯里（1733），见于他的著作《欧几里得无懈可击》。他发现（并不意外）这些公理蕴涵三角形的内角和小于 π，四边形的内角和小于 2π。他还发现（更令人意外）两条直线可以是渐近的；也就是说，它们可以任意地相互接近而不相交。萨凯里认为这“与直线的本性相悖”，但这仍然不是矛盾。事实上，这是对非欧世界的一次准确的惊鸿一瞥。

If one takes the other axioms, and adds the axiom that parallels are not unique, the hope was that a contradiction would be discovered. The first to pursue the elusive contradiction was Saccheri (1733), in his book Euclid Vindicated from Every Blemish. He found, not surprisingly, that these axioms imply that the angle sum of a triangle is less than π and the angle sum of a quadrilateral is less than 2π. He also found, more surprisingly, that two lines could be asymptotic; that is, they could approach each other arbitrarily closely without meeting. Saccheri found this ‘abhorrent to the nature of straight lines’, but still it was not a contradiction. In fact, it was an accurate glimpse of the non-Euclidean world.

6.2 非欧几何

6.2 Non-Euclidean Geometry

在十九世纪最初的几十年里，数学家们开始以不那么怀疑的态度探索这个假设的非欧世界。高斯本人了解平行线不唯一的种种推论，但不敢发表。直到 1820 年代，才由鲍耶和罗巴切夫斯基各自独立地发展并发表了基本定理。1830 年代，明金的工作中也有一个暗示：非欧三角学的公式在某些马鞍形曲面上是有意义的。这些公式与球面三角学的公式相似，只是把正弦和余弦换成了它们的双曲类似物；如果把“直线”取为曲面上的测地线——即长度最短的曲线——它们就成立。但明金的发现还不足以完全实现非欧几何，因为他的曲面是不完备的——它们不允许在每个方向上都有无限的“直线”。

In the first decades of the nineteenth century, mathematicians began to explore the hypothetical non-Euclidean world less sceptically. Gauss himself was aware of the implications of non-unique parallels, but was afraid to publish them. It was left to Bolyai and Lobachevsky, in the 1820s, to independently develop and publish the basic theorems. There was also a hint, in the work of Minding in the 1830s, that the formulas of non-Euclidean trigonometry made sense on certain saddle-shaped surfaces. These formulas, which are like those of spherical trigonometry except that sine and cosine are replaced by their hyperbolic analogues, hold if ‘lines’ were taken to be geodesics – curves of shortest length – on the surface. But Minding’s discovery fell short of being a full realization of non-Euclidean geometry, because his surfaces were incomplete – they did not admit infinite ‘lines’ in every direction.

模拟非欧几何的困难最终由贝尔特拉米（1868）通过放宽“距离”的定义而克服。事实上，贝尔特拉米找到了非欧几何的若干实现，即模型，其中的“直线”相当优美而自然。也许最容易理解的是图 17 所示的共形圆盘模型。

The difficulties of modelling non-Euclidean geometry were finally overcome by Beltrami (1868) by relaxing the definition of ‘distance’. In fact, Beltrami found several realizations, or models, of non-Euclidean geometry in which ‘lines’ were quite elegant and natural. Perhaps the easiest to grasp is the conformal disc model shown in Figure 17.

在这幅图中，“平面”是圆盘的内部，因此它的“点”就是圆盘边界内部的点。它的“直线”是与圆盘边界垂直的圆弧，“角”就是“直线”之间的实际夹角。（这就是该模型被称为共形的原因，共形的意思是它如实地表示角。）距离的概念是通过某个我不在此陈述的公式给出的，但可以通过以下方式对“距离”获得一个大致的印象。

In this figure, the ‘plane’ is the interior of the disc, so its ‘points’ are points inside the disc boundary. Its ‘lines’ are circular arcs perpendicular to the disc boundary and ‘angles’ are the actual angles between ‘lines’. (This is why the model is called conformal, which means that it faithfully represents angles.) The concept of distance is via a certain formula I will not state, but one can get a general impression of ‘distance’ as follows.

图中有许多“三角形”，它们的形状都相同，因为它们的角都是 π/2,π/3,π/7（因此，与所有非欧三角形一样，它们的内角和 <π）。由于在非欧几何中形状相同的图形大小也相同，这些三角形都具有相同的非欧大小。特别地，可以看出非欧平面及其“直线”是无限的，因为每条直线在通往圆盘边界的途中都穿过无穷多个三角形。还可以猜到，“直线”是“长度”最短的曲线，因为如果用所穿过的三角形个数来度量，“直线”似乎给出了任意两点之间的最短路径。

The figure shows many ‘triangles’, each of which has the same shape because it has angles π/2,π/3,π/7 (thus, like all non-Euclidean triangles, they have angle sum <π). Since figures of the same shape have the same size in non-Euclidean geometry, these triangles all have the same non-Euclidean size. In particular, one sees that the non-Euclidean plane and its ‘lines’ are infinite, because each line passes through infinitely many triangles on its way to the disc boundary. One can also guess that the ‘lines’ are curves of shortest ‘length’, because it appears that a ‘line’ gives the shortest path between any two points, if measured by the number of triangles it passes through.

6.3 非欧几何的影响

6.3 The Impact of Non-Euclidean Geometry

非欧几何最终断绝了从欧几里得其他公理推出平行公理的任何可能，因为其他公理在贝尔特拉米的模型中成立，而平行公理不成立。在图 18 中可以直接看到平行公理的失效：其中 l 是一条“直线”，P 是 l 外的一点，两条“直线” m 和 n 都经过 P 且不与 l 相交。

Non-Euclidean geometry finally killed any chance of deducing the parallel axiom from Euclid’s other axioms, because the other axioms hold in Beltrami’s model but the parallel axiom does not. One can see the failure of the parallel axiom directly in Figure 18, where l is a ‘line’, P is a point outside l, and two ‘lines’ m and n pass through P without meeting l.

当然，也存在平行公理确实成立的模型，因此我们看到，该公理独立于其他公理，并且可以替换为断言存在多条平行线的非欧平行公理，而不必担心矛盾。这一发现——数学中的第一个独立性证明——的直接影响，是人们更加不信任以欧几里得几何作为数学的基础，而更加支持算术。事实上，正如我们将在下一节看到的，一种基于实向量空间的几何的算术方法已经准备就绪，尽管很少有数学家准备好去理解它。

Of course, there are models in which the parallel axiom does hold, so we see that the axiom is independent of the other axioms, and it can be replaced by the non-Euclidean parallel axiom, stating the existence of multiple parallels, without fear of contradiction. The immediate effect of this discovery – the first independence proof in mathematics – was increased distrust of Euclid’s geometry as a foundation of mathematics, and increased support for arithmetic. In fact, as we will see in the next section, an arithmetic approach to geometry based on real vector spaces was ready to be rolled out, though few mathematicians were ready to understand it.

当然，分析的算术化正在赢得支持。由于魏尔斯特拉斯的影响——他于 1864 年独立于戴德金提出了实数的算术定义——关于连续函数的基本定理（从而代数基本定理）的算术证明在 1870 年代开始流传。

Certainly, arithmetization of analysis was gaining support. Thanks to the influence of Weierstrass, who had proposed an arithmetic definition of real numbers independently of Dedekind in 1864, arithmetical proofs of the basic theorems on continuous functions (and hence of the fundamental theorem of algebra) began to circulate in the 1870s.

另一个引人注目的发现，是庞加莱和克莱因在 1880 年代发现：非欧几何早已存在于数学之中。他们注意到，复数单位圆盘上函数的行为具有非欧的周期性，而这一现象早先已被高斯、黎曼和施瓦茨观察到，只是他们没有意识到它的几何意义。施瓦茨（1872）甚至画出了一幅圆盘图（图 19），它正是共形圆盘模型被全等的非欧三角形所作的镶嵌！

Another remarkable discovery, by Poincaré and Klein in the 1880s, was that non-Euclidean geometry was already present in mathematics. They noticed that there was non-Euclidean periodicity in the behaviour of functions on the unit disc of complex numbers, and that the phenomenon had been observed earlier, by Gauss, Riemann, and Schwarz, without realizing its geometric significance. Schwarz (1872) even produced a diagram (Figure 19) of the disc that is none other than a tessellation of the conformal disc model by congruent non-Euclidean triangles!

这些发现巩固了非欧几何在数学中的地位，事实上也巩固了它在复数算术中的地位。

These discoveries cemented the position of non-Euclidean geometry in mathematics, and indeed in the arithmetic of complex numbers.

在几何之外，平行公理的独立性预示了数学中的其他独立性证明。在一个句子 σ 不知道是否为公理集 Σ 的推论的情况下，人们可能希望通过找到 Σ 的两个模型来证明 σ 独立于 Σ：一个满足 σ，另一个满足 σ 的否定。我们稍后会提到一些例子。

Outside geometry, the independence of the parallel axiom foreshadowed other independence proofs in mathematics. In cases where a sentence σ is not known to be a consequence of axioms Σ, one might hope to prove σ independent of Σ by finding two models of Σ: one satisfying σ and the other satisfying the negation of σ. We will mention examples later.

平行公理的独立性也是逆数学的先声；逆数学是这样一个分支，人们在其中寻找证明某个给定定理的“正确公理”。平行公理是证明（比如说）勾股定理的正确公理，因为二者是等价的——在给定欧几里得其他公理的前提下——但仅凭这些公理，二者都无法证明。事实上，平行公理正是证明那一大批定理的正确公理，这些定理在平行公理的独立性被认识之前，就已被证明与平行公理等价。

The independence of the parallel axiom was also a harbinger of reverse mathematics, a branch in which one seeks the ‘right axiom’ to prove a given theorem. The parallel axiom is the right axiom to prove, say, the Pythagorean theorem because the two are equivalent – given Euclid’s other axioms – but neither can be proved from these axioms alone. Indeed, the parallel axiom is the right axiom to prove the host of theorems shown to be equivalent to the parallel axiom before its independence was known.

正如我们将在第 9 节看到的，独立性现象成为二十世纪数学中的一个重大课题，改变了我们思考真理与证明的方式。

As we will see in Section 9, the phenomenon of independence became a big story in twentieth-century mathematics, changing the way we think about truth and proof.

6.4 几何的算术化

6.4 Arithmetization of Geometry

在一本名为《扩张论》（Die Ausdehnungslehre）的不为人知的出版物中，格拉斯曼（1844）引入了一种革命性的几何方法，其基础就是我们今天所说的实向量空间。遗憾的是，格拉斯曼的写作风格对他的同时代人来说艰涩难懂，即使他在 1847 年发表了一个强调内积作用的简化版本也是如此。第一个欣赏他工作的人是皮亚诺（1888），他给出了实向量空间的一个公理系统，这是最早的现代公理系统之一。有趣的是，格拉斯曼把这一思想的萌芽归功于莱布尼茨 1679 年的一份名为《几何特征》（Characteristica Geometrica）的简略手稿。如果格拉斯曼真的在《几何特征》中看到了向量空间，那他是唯一这样做的人（其他人认为《几何特征》预示的是组合拓扑这一截然不同的学科）。至少，格拉斯曼应得的主要功劳在于认识到向量空间的概念，并看出必须添加什么才能使它真正具有几何性。

In an obscure publication called Die Ausdehnungslehre (extension theory), Grassmann (1844) introduced a revolutionary approach to geometry, based on what we now call real vector spaces. Unfortunately, Grassmann’s style was impenetrable to his contemporaries, even when he published a simplified version in 1847, emphasizing the role of the inner product. The first to appreciate his work was Peano (1888), who gave an axiom system for real vector spaces, one of the first modern axiom systems. Interestingly, Grassmann credited the germ of the idea to a sketchy manuscript of Leibniz from 1679 called Characteristica Geometrica. If Grassmann really saw vector spaces in the Characteristica he was the only one to do so (others have thought that the Characteristica foreshadows the very different subject of combinatorial topology). At the very least, Grassmann deserves most of the credit for recognizing the vector space concept, and for seeing what must be added to make it truly geometric.

今天，我们在数学中处处都能看到向量空间，因此大多数数学家都熟悉其基本思想。有一个集合 V，其中的对象称为向量，它们可以乘以实数，也可以相加。其中包括一个零向量 0，并且对每个向量 a，有一个向量 −a，称为 a 的负向量。向量受以下公理支配。第一组公理说，向量和 + 的行为与普通的和一样；即对 V 中任意的 u,v,w：

Today we see vector spaces all over mathematics, so most mathematicians are familiar with the basic ideas. There is a set V of objects called vectors, which can be multiplied by real numbers and added. They include a zero vector 0 and, for each vector a a vector −a called the negative of a. Vectors are governed by the following axioms. The first group say that the vector sum + behaves like ordinary sum; that is, for any u,v,w in V:

u+v=v+u,u+(v+w)=(u+v)+w,u+0=u,u+(−u)=0.

第二组公理说，向量的倍数的行为与数的倍数一样；即对 ℝ 中任意的 a,b 和 V 中任意的 u,v：

And the second group say that multiples of vectors behave like multiples of numbers; that is, for any a,b in ℝ and u,v in V,

a(bu)=(ab)u,1u=u,a(u+v)=au+av,(a+b)u=au+bu.

由这些公理显然可知 ℝ 本身就是一个实向量空间，但一个更有趣的例子是 V=ℝ2，其中向量 (x,y) 的和与倍数，对每个 x,y,a∈ℝ，定义为

It is clear from these axioms that ℝ itself is a real vector space, but a more interesting example is V=ℝ2, with sums and multiples of the vectors (x,y) defined, for each x,y,a∈ℝ, by

(x1,y1)+(x2,y2)=(x1+x2,y1+y2)a(x,y)=(ax,ay).

ℝ2 具有相当多的几何内容。人们可以定义直线、平行线，以及沿给定直线的相对长度概念。例如，可以说非零向量 v 的倍数 tv 构成一条经过 0 的直线，并且 2v 到 0 的距离是 v 的两倍。然而，任意两点之间并没有距离的概念。为了得到自然的距离概念，格拉斯曼引入了内积：

ℝ2 has considerable geometric content. One can define lines, parallel lines, and a relative concept of length along a given line. For example, one can say that the multiples tv of a non-zero vector v form a line through 0, and that 2v is twice as far from 0 as v. However, there is no concept of distance between arbitrary points. To obtain the natural concept of distance, Grassmann introduced the inner product:

(x1,y1)⋅(x2,y2)=x1x2+y1y2.

由这个定义可知，若 v=(x,y)，则

From this definition it follows that if v=(x,y), then

v⋅v=x2+y2=|v|2,

其中 |v| 是由勾股定理给出的 v 到原点 0 的距离。正如格拉斯曼（1847）所指出的，他的内积本质上等价于勾股定理。角的概念也内含于内积之中，因为

where |v| is the distance of |v| from the origin 0 given by the Pythagorean theorem. As Grassmann (1847) pointed out, his inner product is essentially equivalent to the Pythagorean theorem. The concept of angle is also inherent in the inner product, because

u⋅v=|u||v|cos⁡θ,

其中 θ 是从 0 到 u 和到 v 的两条直线之间的夹角。

where θ is the angle between the lines from 0 to u and v.

（注：PDF 原文作“the distance of |v| from the origin”，按文意应指 v 到原点的距离；英文保留原文。）

(Note: the PDF reads “the distance of |v| from the origin”; the sense is the distance of v from the origin. The English is kept as printed.)

6.5 向量几何

6.5 Vector Geometry

上一节表明，笛卡尔的平面（第 4.2 节）——其中的点是实数 x,y 的有序对 (x,y)，距离由勾股定理给出——与带有格拉斯曼内积的向量空间 ℝ2 具有相同的要素。不同之处在于，笛卡尔的代数涉及 x 和 y 的任意多项式，远远超出了欧几里得。格拉斯曼的向量空间 ℝ2 的代数只涉及向量的和与实数倍以及内积，恰好处在刻画欧几里得几何的正确层次上。因此，带有格拉斯曼内积的向量空间 ℝ2 被称为欧几里得平面。

The previous section shows that the plane of Descartes (Section 4.2), in which points are ordered pairs (x,y) of reals x,y and distance is given by the Pythagorean theorem, has the same ingredients as the vector space ℝ2 with Grassmann’s inner product. The difference is that the algebra of Descartes, which involves arbitrary polynomials in x and y, goes much further than Euclid. Grassmann’s algebra of the vector space ℝ2, involving only sums and real multiples of vectors, and the inner product, is at just the right level to capture Euclid’s geometry. For this reason, the vector space ℝ2 with Grassmann’s inner product is called the Euclidean plane.

格拉斯曼的向量几何还可以毫不费力地推广到任意维数。通过处理实数的 n 元组 (x1,x2,…,xn)，人们可以在任意维数中研究几何，而无须借助可视化，从而突破了曾经束缚希腊人的维数障碍。

Grassmann’s vector geometry also generalizes to any number of dimensions with no extra effort. By working with n-tuples (x1,x2,…,xn) of real numbers, one can do geometry in any number of dimensions without the need for visualization, thus breaking the dimension barrier that held back the Greeks.

在另一个方向上，通过推广内积的概念来推广“距离”的定义是很有用的。一个著名的例子是闵可夫斯基空间，它由闵可夫斯基（1908）定义，作为爱因斯坦狭义相对论的框架。这是由 4 元组 (t,x,y,z) 构成的空间 ℝ4，其距离由如下内积导出：

In another direction, it is useful to generalize the definition of ‘distance’ by generalizing the concept of inner product. A famous example is Minkowski space defined by Minkowski (1908) as a setting for Einstein’s special theory of relativity. This is the space ℝ4 of 4-tuples (t,x,y,z) with distance derived from the inner product

(t1,x1,y1,z1)⋅(t2,x2,y2,z2)=−t1t2+x1x2+y1y2+z1z2.

因此，(t,x,y,z) 到原点的闵可夫斯基距离的平方等于 −t2+x2+y2+z2，它有时是负的。闵可夫斯基空间是物理学的自然空间，其中 t 代表时间，x,y,z 是空间三个维度的变量。但在数学上，考察去掉 z 坐标所得的三维空间同样有趣。

Thus the Minkowski distance of (t,x,y,z) from the origin has square equal to −t2+x2+y2+z2, which is sometimes negative. Minkowski space is the natural space for physics, where t stands for time and x,y,z are variables for the three dimensions of space. But mathematically it is equally interesting to look at the 3-dimensional space obtained by dropping the z coordinate.

在这个空间中有一个“半径为 −1 的球面”，它由满足 |v|2=−1 的点 v=(t,x,y) 组成，即

In this space there is a ‘sphere of radius −1’, consisting of the points v=(t,x,y) with |v|2=−1, that is

−t2+x2+y2=−1;or / 即t2−x2−y2=1.

这正是图 20 所示的双曲面。就闵可夫斯基距离而言，这个双曲面上的几何正是贝尔特拉米的非欧几何！在图 20 中（依据柏林自由大学康拉德·波尔蒂尔的一幅图），我们标示了共形圆盘模型（图 17）中的三角形如何对应于双曲面上在闵可夫斯基距离意义下相等的三角形。

This is none other than the hyperboloid, shown in Figure 20. In terms of Minkowski distance, the geometry on this hyperboloid is none other the non-Euclidean geometry of Beltrami! In Figure 20 (based on one due to Konrad Polthier of the Free University of Berlin) we have indicated how triangles in conformal disc model (Figure 17) correspond to triangles on the hyperboloid that are equal in the sense of Minkowski distance.

闵可夫斯基空间为兰伯特早在 1766 年提出的大胆想法（见第 4.5 节）提供了实质内容：非欧几何也许在一个虚半径的球面上成立。

Minkowski space gives substance to the wild idea of Lambert from back in 1766 (mentioned in Section 4.5), that non-Euclidean geometry might hold on a sphere of imaginary radius.

欧几里得空间与闵可夫斯基空间表明，ℝ 是几何（无论欧氏的还是非欧的）的自然而便利的基础。下一个问题是：ℝ 的基础是什么？在第 8 节中，我们将看到对这个问题的两种回答。但首先，我们需要在第 7 节中更仔细地审视 ℝ 本身，以体会它的基础可能是多么微妙。

Euclidean and Minkowski spaces show that ℝ is a natural and convenient foundation for geometry, both Euclidean and non-Euclidean. The next question is: what is a foundation for ℝ? In Section 8 we will see two answers to this question. But first we need to take a closer look at ℝ itself, in Section 7, to appreciate how subtle its foundation may be.

6.6 哲学问题

6.6 Philosophical Issues

贝尔特拉米对非欧几何建模的关键一步，是他决定推广长度的概念。他之所以敢于这样做，是受到了他对黎曼（1854）的阅读的鼓舞；那是一部关于几何基础的开创性著作，首次发表于 1868 年。在一种全新的、影响深远的几何方法（今称黎曼几何）中，黎曼把笛卡尔的算术化几何从平面推广到任意维数 n 的弯曲空间。空间的点不再用有序数对表示，而是用有序 n 元组 (x1,x2,…,xn) 表示。距离不再由“勾股”公式给出，而是由“无穷小勾股”公式借助微积分得到。“无穷小勾股”性质意味着：空间的几何（例如由三角形内角和所显示的）在小区域内趋近于欧氏几何，但在大区域内可能偏离它。一个例子是球面上的几何，其中小三角形的内角和接近 π，而大三角形的内角和则远大于 π。

A key step in Beltrami’s modelling of non-Euclidean geometry was his decision to generalize the concept of length. He was emboldened to do this by his reading of Riemann (1854), a ground-breaking work in the foundations of geometry that was first published in 1868. In a sweeping new approach to geometry (now known as Riemannian geometry), Riemann generalized the arithmetized geometry of Descartes from the plane to curved spaces of any dimension n. The points of the space, instead of being represented by ordered pairs of numbers, were represented by ordered n-tuples (x1,x2,…,xn). And distance, instead of being given by the ‘Pythagorean’ formula, was obtained by calculus from an ‘infinitesimal Pythagorean’ formula. The ‘infinitesimal Pythagorean’ property means that the geometry of the space (as manifested by the angle sum of a triangle, for example) approaches Euclidean geometry in small regions, but may diverge from it in large regions. An example is the geometry of the sphere, where small triangles have angle sum close to π, but large triangles have angle sum much greater than π.

球面是常正曲率空间的一个例子。黎曼曾简略地考察过常负曲率空间，但发现这类空间呈现非欧几何、并且其“直线”（长度最短的曲线）可以简单地用圆弧来建模（如图 17 所示）的，是贝尔特拉米。因此，黎曼几何是对几何的彻底算术化，为欧氏几何、非欧几何以及各种弯曲几何指明了算术基础的方向。

The sphere is an example of a space with constant positive curvature. Riemann looked briefly at spaces of constant negative curvature, but it was Beltrami who noticed that such spaces exhibit non-Euclidean geometry, and that their ‘lines’ (curves of shortest length) can be modelled simply by circular arcs, as in Figure 17. Thus Riemannian geometry is a thoroughgoing arithmetization of geometry, pointing the way to an arithmetic basis for Euclidean, non-Euclidean, and all kinds of curved geometries.

黎曼和贝尔特拉米所带来的革命，引发了关于几何的本性及其在数学中的地位的若干问题。

The revolution wrought by Riemann and Beltrami raised several issues about the nature of geometry and its place in mathematics.

直觉与逻辑。模型表明，欧氏几何与非欧几何同样可靠，而实数为二者提供了基础（也为微积分和数学物理提供了基础）。剩下的就是为实数找到一个好的基础；但愿它能建立在自然数的算术之上。正如我们所知，戴德金找到了一种做到这一点的方法（第 5.3 节）。

Intuition and logic. Models show that Euclidean and non-Euclidean geometries are equally sound, and the real numbers provide a foundation for both (and also for calculus and mathematical physics). It remains to find a good foundation for the real numbers; hopefully based on the arithmetic of natural numbers. As we know, Dedekind found one way to do this (Section 5.3).

意义与存在。但实数所涉及的不只是算术；它还涉及某种关于无穷的假设。有多少假设是必要的、又有多少是正当的？

Meaning and existence. But the real numbers involve more than arithmetic; namely, some assumption about infinity. How much is it necessary, and legitimate, to assume?

离散与连续。弥合离散与连续之间的鸿沟，本质上就是用自然数来定义实数的问题。因此，弥合这道鸿沟（以及把几何算术化）的可能性，取决于对无穷作出何种假设才是正当的。

Discrete and continuous. Bridging the gap between discrete and continuous is essentially the problem of defining real numbers in terms of natural numbers. Hence the possibility of bridging the gap (and arithmetizing geometry) depends on what it is legitimate to assume about infinity.

7 集合论及其悖论

7 Set Theory and Its Paradoxes

预览

PREVIEW

戴德金对实数的定义开启了数学思想的一个新时代，在这个时代里，无穷集合被视为数学对象。这不受许多数学家欢迎，他们秉持实无穷不可接受的古老观点。事实上，在某些圈子里，对实无穷的抵制一直持续到今天。

Dedekind’s definition of real numbers opened a new era in mathematical thought, in which infinite sets were viewed as mathematical objects. This was unwelcome to many mathematicians, who took the ancient view that actual infinity was unacceptable. Indeed, in some quarters, resistance to actual infinity continues to this day.

更不受欢迎的是康托尔（1874）的发现：实数构成一个不可数集合——它无法被巧妙地当作仅仅是潜无穷而非实无穷来处理。

Even more unwelcome was the discovery of Cantor (1874) that the real numbers form an uncountable set – one that cannot be finessed as a merely potential infinity rather than actual.

但不可数性还不是最后一根稻草。康托尔（1891）找到了他的论证的一个简单推广，表明不存在最大的集合。事实上，对任何集合 S，S 的子集都比 S 的元素多。由此可知，不存在“所有集合的集合”，因而并非每个性质都由某个集合来实现。特别地，不存在实现“X 是一个集合”这一性质的集合。就连戴德金也为这一发展感到不安。

But uncountability was not the last straw. Cantor (1891) found a simple generalization of his argument that shows there is no largest set. Indeed, for any set S, the subsets of S are more numerous than members of S. It follows that there is no ‘set of all sets’ and therefore not every property is realized by a set. In particular, there is no set that realizes the property ‘X is a set’. Even Dedekind was worried by this development.

7.1 康托尔之前

7.1 Before Cantor

我们在第 2.3 节提到过希腊人对无穷心存疑虑，并解释了他们如何尽可能地回避它。尽管如此，希腊人确实使用了无穷过程，而且用得非常巧妙。他们在实践中的回避，意味着只考虑一个无穷整体或无穷过程的任意有限部分——即“潜”无穷而非“实”无穷。

In Section 2.3 we mentioned that the Greeks were suspicious of infinity, and explained how they avoided it as far as possible. Nevertheless, the Greeks certainly used infinite processes, and very ingeniously at that. Their avoidance in practice meant considering arbitrary finite parts of an infinite totality or process – the ‘potential’ rather than the ‘actual’ infinite.

实无穷之所以被回避，是因为它具有看似悖论的性质，例如它似乎违反了“整体大于部分”这一原则。随着希腊学术在中世纪和文艺复兴时期的复兴，这一悖论重新浮现。例如，伽利略指出了如下对应：

The actual infinite was avoided because of its seemingly paradoxical properties, such as apparent violation of the principle that ‘the whole is greater than the part’. This paradox resurfaced with the revival of Greek learning in Medieval and Renaissance times. For example, Galileo pointed out the correspondence

1234…↕↕↕↕↕12223242…

它似乎表明，正整数的整体并不比由平方数构成的那一部分更大。

which seemingly shows the whole collection of positive integers to be no greater than its part consisting of squares.

直到十九世纪末，这种关系——某个集合的一部分与其整体之间的一一对应——一直被认为是悖论性的。但最终，一一对应被视为比较无穷集合的正确方式。事实上，戴德金（1888）把“其整体能与其一部分建立一一对应”作为无穷集合的定义性性质，从而把一个悖论变成了一个定义。能够彼此建立一一对应的两个集合称为等势的，或具有相同的基数。

Until the late nineteenth century this kind of relationship – a one-to-one correspondence between a part and the whole of some collection – was considered paradoxical. But eventually one-to-one correspondence came to be seen as the right way to compare infinite sets. Indeed, Dedekind (1888) took the defining property of an infinite set to be that its whole can be put in one-to-one correspondence with a part, thus turning a paradox into a definition. Two sets that can be put in one-to-one correspondence with one another are called equinumerous or of the same cardinality.

许多集合与正整数集 ℕ 等势。例如：

Many sets are equinumerous with the set ℕ of positive integers. For example:

  1. 全体整数之集 ℤ，通过如下对应与 ℕ 等势：1234567…↕↕↕↕↕↕↕↕01−12−23−3…
  2. 正有理数之集 ℚ+，通过如下对应：123456789…↕↕↕↕↕↕↕↕↕↕1/12/11/23/11/34/13/22/31/4…其中下面一行按组列出互不相同的分数 m/n：先是 m+n=2 的，然后是 m+n=3 的，再是 m+n=4 的，依此类推。
  3. 于是，用列出 ℤ 的同一技巧，可以证明全体有理数之集 ℚ 与 ℕ 等势：先列出 0，然后对每个正有理数交替列出它的正形式和负形式。
  1. The set ℤ of all integers, equinumerous with ℕ via the correspondence1234567…↕↕↕↕↕↕↕↕01−12−23−3…
  2. The ℚ+ of positive rationals, via the correspondence123456789…↕↕↕↕↕↕↕↕↕↕1/12/11/23/11/34/13/22/31/4…where the bottom line lists the distinct fractions m/n in groups: first those with m+n=2, then those with m+n=3, those with m+n=4, and so on.
  3. The set ℚ of all rationals can then be shown equinumerous with ℕ by the same trick used to list ℤ: list 0 first, then alternately list the positive and negative form of each positive rational.

这些结果表明，ℤ、ℚ+ 和 ℚ 都可以像 ℕ 一样被看作“潜”无穷。戴德金在 1874 年沿着同一思路得到了一个更强的结果：全体代数数（整系数多项式方程的解）之集与 ℕ 等势。因此它也可以被看作“潜”无穷。有了这些结果，关于实无穷的大多数古老恐惧都可以打消了——因为似乎每一种无穷都只是“潜”无穷——但一个巨大的意外就在眼前。

These results show that ℤ, ℚ+, and ℚ can all be viewed as ‘potential’ infinities like ℕ. An even stronger result along the same lines was found by Dedekind in 1874: the set of all algebraic numbers (solutions of polynomial equations with integer coefficients) is equinumerous with ℕ. So it too can be viewed as a ‘potential’ infinity. With these results most of the ancient fears about actual infinity could be dismissed – because every infinity seemed to be merely ‘potential’ – but there was a big surprise just around the corner.

7.2 康托尔的对角线论证

7.2 Cantor’s Diagonal Argument

康托尔（1874）证明了实数与正整数不等势。也就是说，正整数与实数的任何配对

Cantor (1874) proved that the real numbers are not equinumerous with the positive integers. That is, any pairing of positive integers with real numbers,

1234567…↕↕↕↕↕↕↕↕x1x2x3x4x5x6x7,

都不能包含所有实数。事实上，给定任何实数列 x1,x2,x3,x4,…，我们都可以明确地描述一个不在该列中的实数 x。1874 年的证明不易理解——尤其是对一个对此毫无准备的数学界来说——但康托尔（1891）给出了另一个证明，以最大的清晰度得到了“见证” x。这就是著名的（或者在某些人看来，臭名昭著的）对角线论证。

fails to include all the real numbers. In fact, given any list x1,x2,x3,x4,… of real numbers we can explicitly describe a real number x not on the list. The 1874 proof was not easy to follow – especially for a mathematical community completely unprepared for it – but Cantor (1891) gave another proof which obtains the ‘witness’ x with maximum clarity. This is the famous (or, to some, notorious) diagonal argument.

实数 x1,x2,x3,x4,… 可以有许多种给出方式，但为具体起见，我们假定它们以无限小数的形式给出。我们还忽略小数点前的数字，因此可以想象这些数如图 21 那样排列，只显示小数点后的数字：

There are many ways in which the real numbers x1,x2,x3,x4,… can be given, but to be specific we will suppose they are given as infinite decimals. We will also ignore digits before the decimal point, so we can imagine the numbers displayed as in Figure 21, showing just the digits after the decimal point:

图 21 还显示了 x 的前几位数字。我们通过使 x 在第 n 位小数上与 xn 不同，来保证对每个 xn 都有 x≠xn（并且在 x 中不使用数字 0 和 9，因为含有这些数字的数即使数字不同也可能相等——例如 0.4999…=0.5000…）。具体地，我们定义 x 为

Figure 21 also shows the first few digits of x. We ensure that x≠each xn by being different in the nth decimal place (and not using the digits 0 and 9 in x, because numbers with these digits can be the same even though their digits are different – for example 0.4999…=0.5000…). Specifically, we define x by

第 n 位 / nth digit of x={2若 xn 的第 n 位为 1 / if nth digit of xn is 11若 xn 的第 n 位不为 1 / if nth digit of xn is not 1.

因此 x 与所有数 x1,x2,x3,x4,… 都不同，从而给定的数列不包含所有实数。正因如此，我们说全体实数之集是不可数的——可数集合是指其元素能与正整数配对的集合。

Thus x is different from all the numbers x1,x2,x3,x4,…, hence the given list does not include all real numbers. Because of this, we say that the set of all real numbers is uncountable – a countable set being one whose members can be paired with the positive integers.

由于只有可数集合才能被看作“潜”无穷，实数集 ℝ 不可避免地是一个实无穷。

Since only countable sets can be considered ‘potentially’ infinite, the set ℝ of real numbers is unavoidably an actual infinity.

康托尔的论证之所以称为“对角线”论证，是因为它只涉及表格对角线上的数字，即图中以粗体显示的数字。因此，为了计算 x 的第 n 位数字，我们只需检查每个小数展开式的有限部分——即 xn 的前 n 位数字。我提到这一点，是为了消除一种常见的误解，即认为对角线论证仅仅证明了存在一个不在给定数列 x1,x2,x3,x4,… 中的数 x。事实上，它表明 x 与数 x1,x2,x3,x4,… 本身同样是可构造的。

Cantor’s argument is called ‘diagonal’ because it involves just the digits on the diagonal of the table, shown in bold in the figure. Thus we need only inspect a finite amount of each decimal expansion – namely, the first n digits of xn – to calculate the nth digit of x. I mention this to dispel the common misconception that the diagonal argument merely proves the existence of a number x not on the given list x1,x2,x3,x4,…. In fact it shows that x is just as constructible as the numbers x1,x2,x3,x4,… themselves.

7.3 更高的无穷

7.3 Higher Infinities

对角线论证的本质在于：给定与每个自然数 n 配对的实数 xn，我们可以按如下规则定义一个实数 x，使得对每个 xn 都有 x≠xn：

The essence of the diagonal argument is to say: given a real number xn paired with each natural number n, we can define a real number x≠each xn by the rule

第 n 位 / nth digit of x={2若 xn 的第 n 位为 1 / if nth digit of xn is 11若 xn 的第 n 位不为 1 / if nth digit of xn is not 1,

因为这使得 x 在第 n 位小数上与 xn 不同。类似的论证表明，不可能存在 ℕ 的所有子集的列表 S1,S2,S3,S4,…。因为对任何这样的列表，我们都可以按如下规则定义一个集合 S，使得对每个 Sn 都有 S≠Sn：

because this makes x≠xn in the nth decimal place. A similar argument shows that there can be no list S1,S2,S3,S4,… of all subsets of ℕ. Because for any such list we can define a set S≠each Sn by the rule

n∈S⇔n∉Sn,

因为这一规则使 S 在数 n 处与 Sn 不同。

since this rule makes S different from Sn with respect to the number n.

在他 1891 年的论文中，康托尔把这一思路推进到了尽头，证明了每个集合 X 的子集都比元素多。为了看出原因，假设 X 的每个元素 x 都与 S 的一个子集 Sx 配对。那么我们可以定义 X 的一个子集 S，它在元素 x 处与每个 Sx 都不同。即令

In his 1891 paper Cantor took this train of thought to the end of the line, showing that every set X has more subsets than members. To see why, suppose that each member x of X is paired with a subset Sx of S. But then we can define a subset S of X different from each Sx with respect to the member x. Namely, let

x∈S⇔x∉Sx.

因此，与 X 的元素 x 配对的子集 Sx 的全体，并不包含 X 的所有子集。

Thus a collection of subsets Sx paired with members x of X does not include all subsets of X.

（注：PDF 原文作“paired with a subset Sx of S”，按文意应为 X 的子集；英文保留原文。）
(Note: the PDF reads “paired with a subset Sx of S”; the sense is a subset of X. The English is kept as printed.)

这一结果有些令人不安之处在于，它表明不存在所有集合的集合。如果存在这样一个集合，比如说 X，那么它的子集的全体就会是一个比所有集合的集合还大的集合，这显然是矛盾的。康托尔很快注意到对角线论证的这一推论，但他保持了冷静。（然而，戴德金对这一发展感到意外，并因此推迟了他的著作戴德金［1888］第二版的出版。）历史将会表明，所有集合的全体不是一个集合是很自然的，正如所有正整数的全体不是一个正整数是很自然的一样。然而在当时，由于先前人们相信每个性质都应由某个集合来实现，因而引起了恐慌。在康托尔的发现之后，很清楚这一信念有例外，例如“是一个集合”这一性质。

What is slightly alarming about this result is that it shows that there is no set of all sets. If there were such a set, X say, then the collection of its subsets would be a set bigger than the set of all sets, which is clearly contradictory. Cantor soon noticed this consequence of the diagonal argument, but he remained calm. (Dedekind, however, was surprised by this development, and he delayed publication of a second edition of his book Dedekind [1888] as a result.) History would show that it is natural for the collection of all sets not to be a set, much as it is natural for the collection of all positive integers not to be a positive integer. However, at the time there was alarm because of a previous belief that every property should be realized by a set. After Cantor’s discovery, it was clear that there are exceptions to this belief, such as the property of being a set.

7.4 对角线论证的余波

7.4 Aftermath of the Diagonal Argument

对角线论证是数学基础中的一个关键性发现。在一个方向上，它似乎不可阻挡地通向更高的无穷领域——也通向新的悖论。在另一个方向上，它导致了形式数学局限性的发现：不完全性与算法不可解性，我们将在接下来的两节中看到。它还激起了一类新的怀疑论者的反应，他们的怀疑不仅针对无穷，而且针对逻辑本身。

The diagonal argument was a pivotal discovery in the foundations of mathematics. In one direction it led, seemingly inexorably, to higher realms of infinity – and towards new kinds of paradox. In another direction it led to the discovery of limitations in formal mathematics: incompleteness and algorithmic unsolvability, as we will see in the next two sections. And it also provoked reaction from a new breed of sceptics, whose scepticism was directed not just at infinity but at logic itself.

康托尔发现不存在最大的集合、并非每个性质都由集合来实现，这导致了集合论的发展，即对一般无穷集合、特别是对 ℝ 的系统研究。ℝ 的不可数性仅仅是关于 ℝ 的许多令人困惑的发现中的第一个，它们表明我们自以为了解的数轴比任何人想象的都要复杂。事实上，为了回答关于 ℝ 的许多问题，我们不得不对整个集合宇宙作出假设。

Cantor’s discovery that there is no largest set, and that not every property is realized by a set, led to the development of set theory, a systematic study of infinite sets in general and ℝ in particular. The uncountability of ℝ was merely the first of many confounding discoveries about ℝ, showing that the number line we thought we knew is more complicated than anyone imagined. In fact, to answer many questions about ℝ we have to make assumptions about the whole universe of sets.

另一方面，对角线论证简单且具有计算性的特点，使它可以应用于最朴实的“潜”无穷。例如，它表明不存在所有可计算数的可计算列表。因为如果 x1,x2,x3,… 是可计算数的一个可计算列表，那么对角线数 x 也是可计算的——而它不在列表中。这一结果对于在数学所有领域中什么是可计算的，具有深远的意义。

On the other hand, the simple and computational nature of the diagonal argument makes it applicable to the most down-to-earth ‘potential’ kinds of infinity. For example, it shows that there is no computable list of all computable numbers. Because if x1,x2,x3,… is a computable list of computable numbers then the diagonal number x is also computable – and it is not on the list. This result has profound implications for what can be computed, in all areas of mathematics.

毫不奇怪，对角线论证及其推论并不受所有数学家欢迎。那些本已对无穷心存疑虑的人，例如康托尔在柏林的同事克罗内克，更加激烈地反对 ℝ 这样的集合。魏尔斯特拉斯较为同情，但他劝说康托尔淡化证明中的不可数性一面，转而强调一个正面的成果：对非代数数——即所谓的超越数——的存在性给出一个新的、初等的证明。（这由 ℝ 的不可数性与戴德金关于代数数集可数的结果立即推出。）

Not surprisingly, the diagonal argument and its implications were not welcome to all mathematicians. Those already suspicious of infinity, such as Cantor’s Berlin colleague Kronecker, became even more vehement in their opposition to sets such as ℝ. Weierstrass was more sympathetic, but he persuaded Cantor to tone down the uncountability aspect of the proof and to emphasize instead a positive outcome: a new and elementary proof of the existence of non-algebraic numbers – the so-called transcendental numbers. (This follows immediately from the uncountability of ℝ and Dedekind’s result that the set of algebraic numbers is countable.)

在随后的岁月里，由于希尔伯特等杰出数学家的支持，康托尔的思想逐渐赢得了大多数人的支持。一些反对仍然存在，但随着人们逐渐认识到，如果拒斥各种无穷，就不得不牺牲多少数学，这种反对变得更加微妙。在极端拒斥者中，最突出的是构造主义者，他们只在存在性证明提供了所声称存在的对象的构造时才接受它。这种态度甚至对不持这种态度的数学家也产生了积极影响。例如，我们现在知道如何构造许多对象，例如多项式方程的解，而这些对象最初是用非构造性论证证明其存在的。

In the years that followed, Cantor’s ideas gradually gained the support of the majority, thanks to the support of eminent mathematicians such as Hilbert. Some opposition remained, but it became more nuanced as it was gradually understood how much mathematics has to be sacrificed if various kinds of infinity are rejected. Among the extreme rejectionists, the most prominent are the constructivists, who accept existence proofs only when they provide a construction of the object claimed to exist. This attitude has had a positive influence even on mathematicians who do not share it. For example, we now know how to construct many objects, such as solutions of polynomial equations, first shown to exist by non-constructive arguments.

7.5 哲学问题

7.5 Philosophical Issues

也许值得一提的是，康托尔对 ℝ 的不可数性的第一个证明也是一个对角线论证，只是形式不那么透明。它有相同的本质：逐步构造一个实数 x，并在第 n 步使 x 与实数 xn 不同。然而，那个构造是专门针对实数的，因此康托尔（1891）所发现的向任意集合的惊人推广是新的。还有另一个专门针对 ℝ 的不可数性证明，在我看来更有启发性。它是这样的。

It may be worth mentioning that Cantor’s first proof of the uncountability of ℝ was also a diagonal argument, but in a less transparent form. It had the same essence: constructing a real number x step by step and making x different from the real number xn at step n. However, the construction was specific to real numbers, so the spectacular generalization to arbitrary sets found by Cantor (1891) was new. There is another uncountability proof, specific to ℝ, which is more revealing in my opinion. It goes like this.

给定实数 x1,x2,x3,…，我们用一个长度为 2−n 的区间覆盖每个 xn。那么被覆盖的数轴的总长度至多为

Given real numbers x1,x2,x3,…, we cover each xn by an interval of length 2−n. Then the total length of the number line covered is at most

12+14+18+…=1,

这显然不是整条直线。因此点 x1,x2,x3,… 不可能包含所有实数。这个证明可以加以细化，给出一个未被覆盖的具体的数 x。我们选取 x 的第一位（二进制）数字以避开第一个区间，再选取第二位数字以避开第二个区间，依此类推——到了这一步就很清楚，这个构造是另一个对角线论证。

which is surely not the whole line. So the points x1,x2,x3,… cannot include all real numbers. This proof can be refined to give a specific number x not covered. We choose the first (binary) digit of x to avoid the first interval, then the second digit to avoid the second interval, and so on – at which stage it becomes clear that this construction is another diagonal argument.

事实上，还有另一条通向不可数性的道路，即通过康托尔的序数理论。这虽然很有趣，却引出了另一组问题，我们在此没有篇幅讨论。不可数集合的存在本身就已引出足够多的问题。

There is in fact another route to uncountability, through Cantor’s theory of ordinal numbers. Interesting though this is, it raises another set of issues that we do not have space to discuss here. The existence of uncountable sets raises enough issues on its own.

直觉与逻辑。人类可能在多大程度上理解无穷？戴德金（1888，§66）作了一次大胆的尝试，试图证明无穷集合存在（继波尔查诺 1851，§13 的类似尝试之后）。它基于这样一个事实：只有无穷集合才能与它自身的一个真子集等势：

Intuition and logic. How much understanding of infinity is humanly possible? Dedekind (1888, §66) made an audacious attempt to prove that infinite sets exist (following a similar attempt by Bolzano 1851, §13). It is based on the fact that only an infinite set can be equinumerous with a proper subset of itself:

定理。存在无穷系统。
Theorem. There exist infinite systems.
证明。我自己的思想领域，即一切能够成为我的思想对象的事物的总体 S，是无穷的。因为如果 s 表示 S 的一个元素，那么“s 能够成为我的思想对象”这一思想 s′ 本身也是 S 的一个元素。如果我们把它看作元素 s 的一个变换 ϕ(s)，那么由此确定的 S 的变换 ϕ 具有这样的性质：变换 S′ 是 S 的一部分；并且 S′ 肯定是 S 的真部分，因为 S 中有一些元素……不包含在 S′ 中。
Proof. My own realm of thoughts, i.e. the totality S of all things which can be objects of my thought, is infinite. For if s signifies an element of S, then is the thought s′, that s can be an object of my thought, itself an element of S. If we regard this as a transform ϕ(s) of the element s then has the transformation ϕ of S, thus determined, the property that the transform S′ is part of S; and S′ is certainly a proper part of S, because there are elements in S … which are not contained in S′.

扫兴的人无疑会反驳说，戴德金一生中只有有限多个思想，所以这个“证明”一定有问题。但谁知道戴德金的思想领域究竟是什么呢？戴德金的论证有一些杰出的支持者，例如罗素（1903，357）。

Spoilsports will no doubt object that in his lifetime Dedekind had only a finite number of thoughts, so there must be something wrong with this ‘proof’. But who knows what the realm of Dedekind’s thoughts really is? Dedekind’s argument had some eminent supporters, such as Russell (1903, 357).

波尔查诺和戴德金只考虑了可数集合，但我们也可以争取不可数集合。我们对连续性的表面直觉，是不是对不可数性和／或实无穷的直觉？

Bolzano and Dedekind considered only countable sets, but we might also shoot for uncountable sets. Is our apparent intuition of continuity an intuition of uncountability and/or actual infinity?

意义与存在。在康托尔之前，无穷问题很简单：我们是否接受实无穷？在康托尔之后，问题变得更加复杂：我们接受多少无穷？当发现无穷有无穷多个可能的层次时，就可能有许多不同层次的接受。一些数学家只接受可数无穷集合（潜无穷），另一些接受 ℝ 但不接受 ℝ 的所有子集，如此等等。法国数学家博雷尔、贝尔、勒贝格和阿达马在 1905 年就此展开了一场热烈的辩论，可见于 Ewald（1996，II：1077–86）。博雷尔认为某些程序，例如作出不可数多次选择，是“在数学之外”的；对此，阿达马反驳道：

Meaning and existence. Before Cantor, the question of infinity was simple: do we accept actual infinity or not? After Cantor, the question became more complex: how much infinity do we accept? When infinity is found to have infinitely many possible levels, many different levels of acceptance are possible. Some mathematicians accepted only countably infinite sets (the potential infinite), others accepted ℝ but not all subsets of ℝ, and so on. The French mathematicians Borel, Baire, Lebesgue, and Hadamard had a lively debate about this in 1905, which may be read in Ewald (1996, II: 1077–86). In response to Borel’s view that certain procedures, such as making uncountably many choices, were ‘outside mathematics’, Hadamard retorted:

在我看来，从无穷小微积分的发明到现在，数学的本质性进步都来自于相继吸纳那些对希腊人、文艺复兴时期的几何学家或黎曼的前辈们来说“在数学之外”的概念，因为当时无法描述它们。（见 Ewald 1996，1084）
From the invention of the infinitesimal calculus to the present, it seems to me, the essential progress in mathematics has resulted from successively annexing notions which, for the Greeks or the Renaissance geometers or the predecessors of Riemann, were ‘outside mathematics’ because it was impossible to describe them. (see Ewald 1996, 1084)

离散与连续。ℝ 的不可数性决定性地表明，涉及 ℝ 的数学——例如分析——触及集合论。至少，几何与分析的算术化工程必须在纯算术之外走出相当一段距离：它必须包含一些关于无穷集合的假设。

Discrete and continuous. The uncountability of ℝ conclusively shows that mathematics involving ℝ – such as analysis – touches on set theory. At the very least, the project of arithmetizing geometry and analysis must go some distance beyond pure arithmetic: it must include some assumptions about infinite sets.

在下一节中，我们将考察算术的标准公理系统，并一瞥更远处的关于集合的公理。

In the next section we will look at the standard axiom system of arithmetic, and catch a glimpse of the axioms about sets that lie beyond.

8 形式系统

8 Formal Systems

预览

PREVIEW

集合论及其悖论的突然出现，并不是十九世纪末数学中唯一具有哲学意义的发展。另一个是形式逻辑的出现，更一般地说，是数学形式系统的出现。从 1847 年布尔的《逻辑的数学分析》问世开始，逻辑和数学被翻译成符号体系，在其中演绎本质上就是计算。

The sudden appearance of set theory and its paradoxes was not the only philosophically significant development in late nineteenth-century mathematics. Another was the emergence of formal logic and, more generally, formal systems for mathematics. Beginning with appearance of Boole’s Mathematical Analysis of Logic in 1847, logic and mathematics were translated into symbolism in which deductions were essentially calculations.

一百年前，已知的可供形式化的系统有：算术的（皮亚诺 1889）、几何的（希尔伯特 1899）和集合论的（策梅洛 1908）。还有一个逻辑的形式系统，出自弗雷格（1879）。

A century ago, systems ready for formalization were known for arithmetic (Peano 1889), geometry (Hilbert 1899), and set theory (Zermelo 1908). There was also a formal system for logic, due to Frege (1879).

形式系统复活了莱布尼茨的一个古老梦想：一种推理演算（calculus ratiocinator），借助它，任何命题的真假都可以通过计算来判定。诚然，形式系统的定理可以通过计算得到，所以如果 τ 是 Σ 的一个定理，我们最终会通过系统地生成定理而观察到这一事实。然而，以下问题并不清楚：

Formal systems revived an old dream of Leibniz: a calculus ratiocinator by which the truth of any proposition could be decided by calculation. It is true that the theorems of a formal system Σ are obtainable by calculation, so if τ is a theorem of Σ we will eventually observe this fact by systematically generating theorems. However, it is not clear whether

  1. 所有可在 Σ 中表达的真理是否都是定理；（完全性）
  2. 是否有某条规则，能对每个 τ 判定 τ 是不是定理；（可判定性）
  3. 如果 Σ 证明了 τ，那么 Σ 是否不会证明 τ 的否定。（一致性）
  1. all truths expressible in Σ are theorems, (Completeness)
  2. some rule decides, for each τ, whether τ is a theorem, (Decidability)
  3. if Σ proves τ then Σ does not prove the negation of τ. (Consistency)

尽管如此，这些都是关于有限计算之结果的问题，就像数论中的问题一样。因此人们或许希望用初等手段（希尔伯特称之为“有穷的”）来解决它们。特别地，希尔伯特希望通过一个解决形式集合论一致性问题的纲领，消除对数学中使用无穷的一切疑虑。

Nevertheless, these are all questions about the outcomes of finite computations, like questions of number theory. So one might hope to settle them by elementary means (which Hilbert called ‘finitary’). In particular, by a programme for settling the consistency question for formal set theory, Hilbert hoped to remove all doubt about the use of infinity in mathematics.

8.1 希尔伯特

8.1 Hilbert

在 1890 年代，希尔伯特通过对几何公理及其与代数和实数之关系的透彻研究，使欧几里得几何重新焕发生机。在冯·施陶特和帕施等前辈工作的基础上，他

In the 1890s Hilbert reinvigorated Euclid’s geometry in a thorough study of geometric axioms and their relation to algebra and the real numbers. Building on work of some of his predecessors, such as von Staudt and Pasch, he

  1. 通过明确陈述欧几里得不自觉地使用过的公理，填补了欧几里得体系中的空缺，
  2. 把公理分成概念上不同的类型：关联、顺序、合同、圆的相交，
  3. 从关联公理推出和与积的代数性质，从顺序公理推出它们的顺序性质，
  4. 增加了两条几何本身不需要、但推出实数直线性质所需要的公理：阿基米德公理（断言不存在无穷小）和完备性公理（断言在戴德金的意义上没有空隙）。
  1. filled the gaps in Euclid’s system, by explicitly stating axioms that Euclid had used unconsciously,
  2. grouped the axioms into conceptually different types: incidence, order, congruence, circle intersection,
  3. derived the algebraic properties of sum and product from incidence axioms, and their order properties from the order axioms,
  4. added two axioms not needed for geometry but needed to derive the properties of the real number line: the Archimedean axiom (stating that there are no infinitesimals), and a completeness axiom (stating that there are no gaps, in the sense of Dedekind).

从纳入阿基米德公理和完备性公理可以明显看出，希尔伯特对实数的兴趣不亚于对几何的兴趣。事实上，在他 1899 年的著作《几何基础》（Grundlagen der Geometrie）中，他还给出了一个从非欧几何公理（通过替换平行公理而得到）出发构造 ℝ 的巧妙新方法。

It is evident from the inclusion of Archimedean and completeness axioms that Hilbert was interested in the real numbers as much as he was interested in geometry. In fact, in his 1899 book Grundlagen der Geometrie (Foundations of geometry) he also included an ingenious new construction of ℝ from the axioms of non-Euclidean geometry (obtained by replacing the parallel axiom).

从几何公理推导出 ℝ 在数学中用得不多，但它对哲学作出了一个奇特的贡献。哈特里·菲尔德（1980）在他的《没有数的科学》中改造了希尔伯特的结果，从关于物理空间的公理推出实数的结构。他用这一推导主张 ℝ 在科学中是可以免除的，因此任何人都无须假定它的存在。但对大多数数学家来说，假定 ℝ 的结构存在（无论在物理空间中还是在任何抽象领域中）就等同于假定 ℝ 本身存在。而仅仅为了避免假定 ℝ 的存在，就假定物理空间是阿基米德的、完备的和欧几里得的，这似乎既违背物理学，也违背数学。

The derivation of ℝ from geometric axioms has not been used much in mathematics, but it has made a curious contribution to philosophy. Hartry Field (1980), in his Science without Numbers, adapted Hilbert’s result to derive the structure of the real numbers from axioms about physical space. He used this derivation to claim that ℝ is dispensable in science, and hence that no one need assume its existence. But, to most mathematicians, assuming that the structure of ℝ exists (in physical space or in any abstract realm) is the same as assuming the existence of ℝ itself. And assuming that physical space is archimedean, complete, and Euclidean – merely to avoid assuming the existence of ℝ – seems to defy physics as much as it defies mathematics.

8.2 皮亚诺与策梅洛的系统

8.2 The Systems of Peano and Zermelo

在数学中，得到 ℝ 的更常见方式是通过关于自然数和集合的公理。自然数的公理由戴德金（1888）和皮亚诺（1889）给出，这个系统今称皮亚诺算术，即 PA。皮亚诺承认格拉斯曼（1861）的一个思想：算术的关键概念是归纳。这里的“归纳”不是从特殊情形得出一般结论的粗略想法，而是对一般结论之正确性的铁的保证。这种归纳常被称为完全归纳，因为对于自然数，它涵盖了所有情形。

The more usual way to arrive at ℝ in mathematics is through axioms for the natural numbers and sets. Axioms for the natural numbers were given by Dedekind (1888) and Peano (1889), in a system now called Peano arithmetic, or PA. Peano acknowledged an idea of Grassmann (1861) that the crucial concept of arithmetic is induction. ‘Induction’ here is not the rough idea of drawing a general conclusion from particular cases, but an ironclad guarantee that the general conclusion is correct. This kind of induction is often called complete induction because, for natural numbers, it covers all cases.

之所以能够证明关于任意自然数 n 的一般断言 σ(n)，是因为 n 可以从 0 出发通过反复加 1 而到达。因此，如果我们能证明 σ(0) 成立，并且只要 σ(m) 成立 σ(m+1) 就成立，那么我们就可以确信 σ(n) 对每个自然数 n 都成立。皮亚诺以两种方式把这一思想纳入他的公理系统。

What makes it possible to prove a general claim σ(n) about an arbitrary natural number n is that n can be reached from 0 by repeatedly adding 1. Therefore, if we can prove that σ(0) holds, and that σ(m+1) holds whenever σ(m) holds, then we can be sure that σ(n) holds for each natural number n. Peano built this idea into his axiom system in two ways.

  • 在引入初始数的名称 0 和后继函数 S(m)=m+1 的名称 S（具有适当的性质）之后，他给出了和与积的归纳定义：l+0=l,l+S(m)=S(l+m),l⋅0=0,l⋅S(m)=l⋅m+l.由这些定义可知，函数 + 和 ⋅ 对所有自然数都有定义。例如，+ 的定义中的第一个方程对 m=0 定义了 l+m；第二个方程在 l+m 有定义后定义 l+S(m)，因此由完全归纳，对所有自然数 n 定义了 l+n。同样，在 + 已有定义的前提下，第二对方程对所有 n 定义了 l⋅n。
  • + 和 ⋅ 的定义使得关于数码 0,S(0),SS(0),… 的和与积的所有特殊事实都可以通过代入定义方程而推出。但为了证明一般事实，例如 l+m=m+l，皮亚诺对每个性质 σ 给出了归纳公理：如果 σ(0)，并且对所有 m 有 σ(m)⇒σ(S(m))，那么 σ(n) 对每个 n 都成立。
  • After including names 0 and S for the initial number and the successor function S(m)=m+1, with appropriate properties, he gave inductive definitions of sum and product:l+0=l,l+S(m)=S(l+m),l⋅0=0,l⋅S(m)=l⋅m+l.It follows from these definitions that the functions + and ⋅ are defined for all natural numbers. For example, the first equation in the definition of + defines l+m for m=0; the second defines l+S(m) once l+m is defined, and hence defines l+n for all natural numbers n, by complete induction. Likewise, the second pair of equations defines l⋅n for all n, given that + is already defined.
  • The definitions of + and ⋅ enable all particular facts about sum and product for the numerals 0,S(0),SS(0),… to be derived, by substituting in the defining equations. But to prove general facts, such as l+m=m+l, Peano provides the induction axiom for each property σ: If σ(0) and if σ(m)⇒σ(S(m)) for all m, then σ(n) holds for each n.

（一个等价的归纳公理是：每个自然数集都有最小元素；或者：自然数的递降序列是有限的。以后一种形式，归纳可以追溯到欧几里得。）

(An equivalent induction axiom is that every set of natural numbers has a least member, or that a descending sequence of natural numbers is finite. In the latter form induction goes back to Euclid.)

策梅洛于 1908 年给出了集合论的公理。我们略去细节，但正如策梅洛所承认的，它们在精神上与戴德金或皮亚诺的公理相似。它们断言存在一个起始集合 ∅（空集，可视为 0），存在构造更多集合的运算（除其他外，这些运算允许构造 0 的后继），以及一条无穷公理，断言存在一个包含 0 及其所有后继的集合。还有一条与归纳相似的基础公理。事实上，如果略去无穷公理，策梅洛的集合论与皮亚诺公理本质上具有相同的内容。所以在某种意义上，集合论就是“数论 + 无穷”。

Zermelo gave axioms for set theory in 1908. We omit the details, but they are similar to the Dedekind or Peano axioms in spirit, as Zermelo acknowledged. They assert the existence of a starting set ∅ (the empty set, which can be viewed as 0), operations for building further sets (which, among other things, allow successors of 0 to be built), and an axiom of infinity stating the existence of a set including 0 and all its successors. There is also an axiom of foundation that is similar to induction. Indeed, if the axiom of infinity is omitted, Zermelo’s set theory has essentially the same content as the Peano axioms. So set theory in a sense is ‘number theory + infinity’.

集合论是一个极其强大的系统，能够涵盖几乎所有主流数学。这是因为它具有集合构造原理——例如构成集合 X 的所有子集之集 P(X)——一旦有了无穷集合 X，这些原理就会引起爆炸性的增长。从 1930 年代的希尔伯特开始，人们就对具有较温和的集合构造原理、专为分析量身定制的系统感兴趣。在这些系统中，事实证明我们可以用证明分析中各种定理所需的集合构造原理来度量这些定理的“强度”。（令人惊讶的是，我们常常能找到证明分析定理的“正确的集合构造公理”，这很像发现平行公理是证明许多几何定理的“正确公理”。这一现象在第 6.3 节提到的新领域逆数学中得到研究。）

Set theory is an extremely powerful system, capable of covering virtually all of mainstream mathematics. This is because it has set construction principles – such as forming the set P(X) of all subsets of a set X – that cause explosive growth once an infinite set X is present. Beginning with Hilbert in the 1930s, there has been interest in systems with milder set construction principles, tailored to analysis. In these systems it turns out that we can measure the ‘strength’ of various theorems of analysis by the set construction principles needed to prove them. (It happens surprisingly often that we can find the ‘right set construction axioms’ to prove theorems of analysis, rather like finding the parallel axiom to be the ‘right axiom’ to prove many theorems of geometry. This phenomenon is studied in the new field of reverse mathematics mentioned in Section 6.3.)

8.3 弗雷格的逻辑系统

8.3 Frege’s System for Logic

到目前为止，我们对于如何“形式化”公理以实现莱布尼茨借助计算寻求真理的梦想，一直说得很模糊。缺少的要素是形式逻辑。最初的步骤由布尔（1847）迈出，即后来所称的布尔代数或命题逻辑。布尔注意到，联结词“或”和“与”作用于命题的方式很像和与积。它们满足某些基本恒等式，例如 a+b=b+a 和 ab=ba，由此可以用代数证明复合命题之间的一般恒等式。

So far we have been vague about how axioms may be ‘formalized’ so as to realize Leibniz’s dream of finding truth by calculation. The missing ingredient is formal logic. The first steps were taken by Boole (1847), in what later became known as Boolean algebra or propositional logic. Boole noticed that the connectives ‘or’ and ‘and’ act on propositions rather like sum and product. They satisfy certain basic identities, such as a+b=b+a and ab=ba from which general identities between compound propositions may be proved by algebra.

但命题逻辑对数学来说表达力不够，因为在数学中命题的内部结构很重要。一个数学命题通常包含：

But propositional logic is not expressive enough for mathematics, where the internal structure of a proposition is important. Typically, a mathematical proposition contains:

  • 变元，取值于某个个体域，例如数。
  • 谓词符号，表示该域上的性质或关系。
  • 逻辑符号，不仅包括“与”“或”“非”等联结词，还包括作用于任一变元 x 的量词“对所有 x”和“存在一个 x”。
  • Variables ranging over some domain of individuals, such as numbers.
  • Predicate symbols denoting properties or relations on the domain.
  • Logic symbols which include not only connectives, such as ‘and’, ‘or’, and ‘not’, but also the quantifiers ‘for all x’ and ‘there exists an x’, applied to any variable x.

当纳入这些语言要素时，我们就得到了谓词逻辑的语言。对于谓词逻辑，如何证明有效命题——即对所有域和谓词符号的所有解释都为真的命题——一点也不清楚，但令人惊讶的是，这是可能的。弗雷格在 1879 年给出了一组能够生成它们的公理和推理规则。

When these linguistic elements are included we have the language of predicate logic. For predicate logic it is not at all clear how to prove the valid propositions – that is, those true for all domains and all interpretations of the predicate symbols – but, amazingly, it is possible. Frege in 1879 gave a set of axioms and rules of inference capable of generating them.

我们不在这里列出弗雷格的全部公理和规则。用联结词 ⇒（如果……那么）1 和 ¬（非）以及量词 ∀x（对所有 x）写出，他的公理的例子有

We will not list all of Frege’s axioms and rules here. Examples of his axioms, written in terms of the connectives ⇒ (if … then)1 and ¬ (not) and the quantifier ∀x (for all x), are

  • a⇒(b⇒a)，
  • a⇒(¬¬a)，
  • ∀xP(x)⇒P(c)，其中 c 是不在 P(x) 中出现的字母。
  • a⇒(b⇒a),
  • a⇒(¬¬a),
  • ∀xP(x)⇒P(c), where c is a letter not in P(x).

他的推理规则的例子有

Examples of his rules of inference are

  • 肯定前件式：由 B 和 B⇒A 推出 A，
  • ∀ 引入：由 A(x) 推出 ∀xA(x)。
  • modus ponens: from B and B⇒A infer A
  • ∀ introduction: from A(x) infer ∀xA(x).
1 等价于哲学家偏爱的马蹄形符号 ⊃。
1 Equivalent to the horseshoe symbol ⊃ preferred by philosophers.

弗雷格显然相信他的公理和推理规则足以证明任何有效命题。哥德尔（1930）证明了弗雷格是对的。谓词逻辑的这一完全性定理，是哥德尔对数理逻辑（以及数学哲学）的几项惊人贡献中的第一项。哥德尔对完全性定理的证明顺带证明了谓词逻辑的另外两个重要性质。

Frege apparently believed that his axioms and rules of inference suffice to prove any valid proposition. Gödel (1930) proved that Frege was correct. This completeness theorem for predicate logic was the first of several astonishing contributions of Gödel to mathematical logic (and to the philosophy of mathematics). Gödel’s proof of the completeness theorem incidentally proved two other important properties of predicate logic.

一致语句的建模。如果 Σ 是一个命题集，其逻辑推论不包含矛盾，那么 Σ 有一个模型。也就是说，存在一个个体域 D，以及 Σ 的谓词符号在 D 上的解释，使得 Σ 中的每个命题都为真。

Modelling consistent sentences. If Σ is a set of propositions whose logical consequences include no contradiction then there is a model of Σ. That is, there is a domain D of individuals, and interpretations of the predicate symbols of Σ on D, under which each proposition in Σ is true.

紧致性。如果 Σ 的每个有限子集 Σ0 都有模型，那么 Σ 也有模型。（这由建模性质推出：因为如果每个有限子集 Σ0 都有模型，那么从 Σ0 推不出矛盾。但这样从 Σ 也推不出矛盾，因为任何证明都是有限的，因而只涉及 Σ 的一个有限子集 Σ0。）

Compactness. If each finite subset Σ0 of Σ has a model, then so has Σ. (This follows from modelling, because if each finite subset Σ0 has a model, then no contradiction follows from Σ0. But then no contradiction follows from Σ, since any proof is finite and hence involves only a finite subset Σ0 of Σ.)

8.4 完全性与不完全性

8.4 Completeness and Incompleteness

谓词逻辑的完全性意味着，所有数学定理在如下相对意义上都是可证的：如果 τ 从公理 α1,…,αk 推出，那么蕴涵式 (α1 and … and αk)⇒τ 是有效的，因而在谓词逻辑中可证。（这令人想起罗素［1903］的开篇语：纯粹数学是所有形如“p 蕴涵 q”的命题的类。）

Predicate logic completeness means that all mathematical theorems are provable in the following relative sense. If τ follows from axioms α1,…,αk, then the implication (α1 and … and αk)⇒τ is valid and hence provable in predicate logic. (This calls to mind the opening words of Russell [1903]: pure mathematics is the class of all propositions of the form ‘p implies q’.)

然而，可能存在某个数学领域不能被完全公理化，即我们能写下的任何公理集都不能逻辑地蕴涵该领域的所有真理。正如我们将在下一节看到的，这种情况确实会发生。

However, there may be some area of mathematics that cannot be completely axiomatized, in the sense that no set of axioms we can write down will logically imply all the truths of that area. This actually happens, as we will see in the next section.

8.5 哲学问题

8.5 Philosophical Issues

形式系统刚被引入时，关于它们的许多问题涉及公式的意义以及用来推导定理的方法，例如归纳。

When formal systems were first introduced, many of the questions about them concerned the meaning of the formulas and the methods used to derive theorems, such as induction.

直觉与逻辑。庞加莱在 1894 年对科学中的归纳与数学中的归纳作了有力的对比：

Intuition and logic. Poincaré in 1894 made a forceful contrast between induction in science and in mathematics:

应用于物理科学的归纳总是不确定的，因为它依赖于对宇宙的普遍秩序、即我们之外的秩序的信念。相反，数学归纳……必然地强加于我们，因为它只是对心灵自身的一种性质的肯定。（见 Ewald 1996，II：980）
Induction applied to the physical sciences is always uncertain, because it rests on the belief in a general order of the universe, and order outside us. Mathematical induction … on the contrary, imposes itself necessarily because it is only the affirmation of a property of the mind itself. (see Ewald 1996, II: 980)

通过把归纳描述为心灵的一种性质，他主张归纳属于直觉而非逻辑。无论如何，归纳当然可以表达为数的一种性质。

By describing induction as a property of the mind, he is claiming that induction belongs to intuition, rather than logic. Be that as it may, induction can certainly be expressed as a property of numbers.

既然数学已被化归为算术加上一些集合论，剩下的就是为算术和集合找到合适的公理。对算术来说，归纳似乎既直观又关键——但它是否充分？对集合来说，哪些公理是直观的或充分的并不明显。我们有多大把握认为公认的公理是一致的？

Given the reduction of mathematics to arithmetic plus some set theory, it remains to find suitable axioms for arithmetic and sets. For arithmetic, induction seems both intuitive and crucial – but is it sufficient? For sets, it is not obvious which axioms are intuitive or sufficient. How sure are we that the accepted axioms are consistent?

意义与存在。无穷集合的存在是否可证？正如我们在第 7.5 节看到的，波尔查诺（1851）和戴德金（1888）认为可以，但策梅洛把它作为一条公理。另一方面，一个关于有限数学宇宙的可行理论似乎也不存在。如果我们从策梅洛的集合论中略去无穷公理（或加入它的否定），就得到一个有限集合的理论，但有限集合仍然有无穷多个。所以毫不奇怪，我们找不到有限集合理论的任何有限模型。

Meaning and existence. Is the existence of infinite sets provable? Bolzano (1851) and Dedekind (1888) thought so, as we saw in Section 7.5, but Zermelo took it as an axiom. On the other hand, a workable theory of a finite mathematical universe does not seem to exist either. If we omit Zermelo’s axiom of infinity from his set theory (or add its negation) we obtain a theory of finite sets, but still there are infinitely many finite sets. So, not surprisingly, we cannot find any finite model of the theory of finite sets.

希尔伯特在 1900 年提出了另一个关于存在的问题。我引用 Hilbert（1902，448）中的英译：

Another question about existence was raised by Hilbert in 1900. I quote from the English translation in Hilbert (1902, 448):

如果给一个概念赋予相互矛盾的属性，我就说，在数学上这个概念不存在。例如，平方为 −1 的实数在数学上不存在。但如果能够证明，赋予这个概念的属性在应用有限多个逻辑步骤时永远不会导致矛盾，我就说，这个概念（例如满足某些条件的数或函数）的数学存在性由此得到了证明。
If contradictory attributes be assigned to a concept, I say, that mathematically the concept does not exist. So, for example, a real number whose square is −1 does not exist mathematically. But if it can be proved that the attributes assigned to the concept can never lead to a contradiction by the application of a finite number of logical processes, I say that the mathematical existence of the concept (for example, of a number or a function which satisfies certain conditions) is thereby proved.

对希尔伯特这一主张的一个相当令人满意的辩护，是由哥德尔对谓词逻辑完全性定理的证明所推出的一致语句的建模给出的。如果“赋予该概念的属性”可以用谓词逻辑来表达（这在数学中通常是如此），那么该概念就有一个模型，这个模型可以用来确立它的存在。

A rather satisfying justification of Hilbert’s claim is given by the modelling of consistent sentences that follows from Gödel’s proof of the completeness theorem for predicate logic. If the ‘attributes assigned to the concept’ can be expressed in predicate logic (which is normally the case in mathematics) then the concept has a model, which can serve to establish its existence.

离散与连续。从哥德尔的完全性证明中得到的一致语句的模型，其不利的一面是，它不一定是预期的模型。特别是，如果语句集是可数的——就一切实际目的而言它必定是可数的——那么模型也是可数的。特别地，任何关于连续统的一致语句集都有一个可数模型，这当然不是预期的！这一结果出自斯科伦（1922），称为斯科伦悖论，它实际上并不矛盾。它仅仅意味着，模型中没有一个函数能把模型的“连续统”的元素与自然数配对。但它确实表明，要完全描述连续统是多么困难。

Discrete and continuous. The downside of the model of consistent sentences obtained from Gödel’s completeness proof is that it is not necessarily the intended model. In particular, if the set of sentences is countable – which for all practical purposes it must be – then the model is also countable. In particular any consistent set of sentences about the continuum has a countable model, which is certainly not intended! This result, due to Skolem (1922) and known as the Skolem paradox, is not actually contradictory. It means only that there is no function in the model that pairs the members of its ‘continuum’ with natural numbers. But it certainly shows how hard it is to completely describe the continuum.

一些数学家反对形式化，不仅因为他们不相信某些被形式化的对象，还因为他们认为形式化排除了直觉，而直觉在他们看来是数学的一个不可或缺的要素。原则上，如果找到了数学的一个完全的形式系统，后一种反对意见就可以被驳倒——但这样的系统是找不到的，我们将在下一节看到。无论如何，这一反对意见并不切题。

Some mathematicians objected to formalization, not only because they did not believe in some of the objects being formalized, but also on the grounds that formalization excludes intuition, which they considered to be a vital ingredient in mathematics. The latter objection could have been quashed, in principle, if a complete formal system for mathematics were found – but it won’t be, as we will see in the next section. In any case the objection was beside the point.

即使是形式化最坚定的倡导者，例如希尔伯特，也重视直觉在数学中的作用。他们进行形式化的理由在别处：产生人人都同意是证明的证明。每个人都会同意，一个给定的定理按给定的规则从给定的公理推出，因为这是关于一个任何人都能验证的有限计算的陈述。证明中符号串的解释并不重要。形式化的要点在于，使一致性问题成为一个关于计算的问题；即诸如 0=1 这样的矛盾符号串是否按给定的规则从公理推出。一旦对某个形式系统 F 肯定地回答了这个问题，那么即使是构造主义者也不得不承认 F 是无害的，即使他们并不认为它的所有定理都有意义。

Even the strongest advocates of formalization, such as Hilbert, valued the role of intuition in mathematics. Their reason for formalization was otherwise: to produce proofs that everyone agrees are proofs. Everyone will agree that a given theorem follows from given axioms by given rules, because this is a statement about a finite computation that anyone can verify. The interpretation of the strings of symbols in the proof is beside the point. The point of formalization is, rather, to make the question of consistency a question about computation; namely, whether a contradictory string such as 0=1 follows from the axioms by the given rules. Once this question is answered affirmatively for a formal system F then even constructivists will have to admit that F is harmless, even if they do not consider all its theorems to be meaningful.

这就是希尔伯特纲领，他希望借此证明关于无穷的推理是无害的。正如我们将在下一节看到的，这一纲领并没有像希尔伯特所希望的那样实现，但它确实在数学哲学中引出了引人注目的发展。

This was the Hilbert programme, with which he hoped to prove that reasoning about infinity is harmless. The programme did not turn out as Hilbert hoped, as we will see in the next section, but it did lead to remarkable developments in the philosophy of mathematics.

9 不可解性与不完全性

9 Unsolvability and Incompleteness

预览

PREVIEW
