上一节讨论的形式系统部分地实现了莱布尼茨关于推理演算——一种确立真理的形式系统——的梦想，但只是部分地实现。在本节中，我们考察故事的另一面：形式系统的局限。这些局限源于一个被称为丘奇论题的惊人命题：存在一个完全的、数学上精确的计算定义（以及随之而来的算法、可解问题和不可解问题的精确定义）。

The formal systems discussed in the previous section are a partial realization of Leibniz’s dream of a calculus ratiocinator – a formal system for establishing truth – but only partial. In this section we look at the other side of the story: the limitations of formal systems. The limitations stem from a stunning proposition known as Church’s thesis: there is a complete and mathematically precise definition of computation (and, with it, precise definitions of algorithm, solvable problem, and unsolvable problem).

一个包罗万象的计算定义的可能性，最早由波斯特在 1920 年代想到，而图灵（1936）对它作了最令人信服的论证。就其本性而言，丘奇论题原则上是可以被证伪的，但从未出现过证伪。因此，丘奇论题如今被认为和任何自然律一样得到了充分的证实。

The possibility of an all-embracing definition of computation was first suspected by Post in the 1920s, and most convincingly argued by Turing (1936). By its nature, Church’s thesis can in principle be falsified, but no falsification has ever come to light. So Church’s thesis is now considered to be as well confirmed as any law of nature.

无论如何，我们可以在丘奇论题的基础上建立一个计算理论，而这个理论导致以下引人注目的结果：

At any rate, we can build a theory of computation on Church’s thesis, and this theory leads to the following remarkable results:

  1. 数学中存在算法上不可解的问题。
  2. 任何足够强的算术形式系统都是不完全的或不一致的。
  3. 足够强的算术形式系统的一致性在该系统内不可证。
  1. There are algorithmically unsolvable problems in mathematics.
  2. Any sufficiently strong formal system for arithmetic is incomplete or inconsistent.
  3. The consistency of a sufficiently strong formal system for arithmetic is not provable within the system.

正如我们将在下面概要地说明的，这些结果都由康托尔对角线论证的简单变形推出。

These results, as we will show in outline below, all follow from simple variations on Cantor’s diagonal argument.

9.1 可计算性

9.1 Computability

在十七世纪，当莱布尼茨梦想通过计算来判定真理时，计算的概念有着相当有限的含义。莱布尼茨本人设计过一台能对数做算术的计算机，他无疑也会承认代数是计算。到 1850 年，布尔已经做到用代数计算来处理命题逻辑。但计算的一般定义必须等到约 1900 年数学形式系统发展起来之后。只有到那时，人们才清楚，为了实现莱布尼茨的梦想，计算的定义需要有多宽广。

In the seventeenth century, when Leibniz dreamed of deciding truth by computation, the concept of computation had a rather limited meaning. Leibniz himself had designed a computing machine capable of doing arithmetic on numbers, and no doubt he would have accepted that algebra was computation too. By 1850 Boole had got as far as doing propositional logic by algebraic computation. But a general definition of computation had to wait for the development of formal systems for mathematics, around 1900. Only then did it become clear how broad the definition of computation needed to be in order to make Leibniz’s dream come true.

二十世纪初最有影响的形式系统是怀特海和罗素（1910）的《数学原理》（Principia Mathematica）。《原理》声称展示了如何借助某些规则从特定公理生成数学的所有定理。这些规则原则上是机械的，因此可以不假思索地应用于符号串——消除了人为错误或偏见的一切可能。1920 年代初，波斯特分析并简化了这些规则，直到把它们化归为如下形式：

The most influential formal system in the early twentieth century was the Principia Mathematica of Whitehead and Russell (1910). The Principia claimed to show how all theorems of mathematics could be generated from particular axioms by certain rules. The rules were such that, in principle, they were mechanical and hence could be applied without thought to strings of symbols – eliminating all possibility of human error or bias. In the early 1920s the rules were analysed and simplified by Post, until they were reduced to the form

gW→Wg′,

其中符号串对 (g,g′) 有有限多个。规则 gW→Wg′ 是说：在任何以 g 开头的串中，可以从左边去掉 g，然后在右边添上 g′。波斯特把这样的规则系统称为正规系统。

for a finite number of pairs of symbol strings (g,g′). The rule gW→Wg′ says that, in any string beginning with g, the g may be removed from the left and g′ then attached on the right. Post called such a system of rules a normal system.

波斯特起初认为，正规系统的简单性能使他判定一个给定的符号串是否为《原理》的定理。但后来他发现自己无法预测非常简单的正规系统的行为，并认识到情况与他所希望的恰恰相反：任何计算都可以被一个正规系统模拟，而且不存在判定给定正规系统是否产生给定符号串的一般规则。

Post thought at first that the simplicity of normal systems would enable him to decide whether a given string of symbols was a theorem of Principia or not. But then he found himself unable to predict the behaviour of very simple normal systems, and came to the realization that the situation was the opposite of what he had hoped: any computation can be simulated by a normal system, and there is no general rule for deciding whether a given normal system produces a given string.

波斯特已经瞥见了数理逻辑在随后十五年中将要展开的未来（他自己的叙述见 Post 1941）。然而，他被一个前所未有的困难所阻：如何能确信正规系统的概念（或任何其他定义）完全刻画了计算的概念？他看出这一主张（后来称为丘奇论题或丘奇—图灵论题）有点像一条自然律——需要不断地验证，并面临可能被证伪的风险。

Post had glimpsed the future of mathematical logic as it was to unfold over the next fifteen years (for his account, see Post 1941). However, he was held back by an unprecedented difficulty: how can one be sure that the concept of normal system (or any other definition) completely captures the concept of computation? He saw that this claim (later known as Church’s thesis or the Church–Turing thesis) is something like a law of nature – one in need of continual verification, and at risk of possible falsification.

9.2 不可解性

9.2 Unsolvability

在波斯特的工作尚未发表、不为人知之时，丘奇（1936）和图灵（1936）各自独立地尝试定义计算的概念。图灵的方法（今称图灵机概念）极具说服力，它基本上是对一个用铅笔和纸工作的人类“计算者”的理想化：

While Post’s work remained unpublished and unknown, independent attempts to define the notion of computation were made by Church (1936) and Turing (1936). Turing’s approach (now known as the Turing machine concept) was remarkably convincing, being basically an idealization of a human ‘computer’ working with pencil and paper:

  • 图灵机没有纸，而有一条分成方格的无限长的带子。每个方格可以容纳有限字母表中的一个符号，其中包括空白。
  • 图灵机没有拿铅笔的人，而有一个读写头，它可以处于有限多个内部状态之一（就像心理状态）。读写头每次扫描一个方格，并根据内部状态 qi 和所扫描的符号 Sj，把 Sj 替换为符号 Sk，向左或向右移动一格，并进入状态 ql。
  • Instead of paper, a Turing machine has an infinite tape divided into squares. Each square can hold one from a finite alphabet of symbols, including the blank.
  • Instead of the human with a pencil, a Turing machine has a read/write head that can assume one of a finite number of internal states (like mental states). The head scans one square at a time and, depending on the internal state qi and scanned symbol Sj, replaces Sj by a symbol Sk, moves one square to the left or right, and enters a state ql.

因此，每台图灵机由有限多个形如 qiSjSkRql 或 qiSjSkLql 的五元组来描述。机器的一次计算由一个输入决定，输入包括带子上有限的一串有标记的方格、最初被扫描的方格，以及初始状态。

Each Turing machine is therefore described by finitely many quintuples, of the form either qiSjSkRql or qiSjSkLql. A computation of the machine is determined by an input, consisting of a finite sequence of marked tape squares, the square initially scanned, and the initial state.

稍加练习，就很容易用图灵机计算来实现纸笔计算。秘诀在于想象：如果每次只允许看一个符号，计算该如何进行。需要考虑的最雄心勃勃的计算，是通用图灵机的计算：一台机器 U，它能接受任意图灵机 T 的描述和任意输入 I，并模拟 T 在 I 上的计算。

With a little practice it is easy to realize pencil-and-paper computations by Turing machine computations. The secret is to imagine how the computation could be done if one is allowed to view only one symbol at a time. The most ambitious computation one needs to think about is that of a universal Turing machine: a machine U that can take the description of an arbitrary Turing machine T, and arbitrary input I, and simulate the computation of T on I.

需要克服的第一个困难是，U 和任何其他图灵机一样，只有有限的符号字母表和有限多个内部状态。U 若要读取 T 的描述，这个描述就必须用一个固定的有限字母表来书写。例如，可以使用字母表 {q,S,L,R,′}，并用撇号 ′ 把 qi 改写为 q′…′（带 i 个撇号的 q），把 Sj 改写为 S′…′（带 j 个撇号的 S）。因此，T 的描述中的单个符号必须被替换为一个符号串，这个符号串必然分布在 U 的带子上的一串方格中。

The first difficulty to overcome is that U, like any other Turing machine, has only a finite alphabet of symbols and finitely many internal states. If U is even to read the description of T that description must be written in a fixed finite alphabet. For example, one could use the alphabet {q,S,L,R,′}, and use the prime symbol ′ to rewrite qi as q′…′ (q with i primes) and to rewrite Sj as S′…′ (S with j primes). Thus a single symbol in the description of T must be replaced by a string of symbols, necessarily spread over a sequence of squares of U’s tape.

自然，这使得 U 对 T 的模拟相当缓慢（U 需要不断地“回头参照” T 的描述，以执行 T 计算的每一步，这也使模拟变慢）。尽管如此，原则上可以看出为什么通用图灵机存在，以及 U 能够逐步模拟 T 在给定输入上所做的事。（今天，通用图灵机无处不在；任何常见的编程语言都等价于一台通用图灵机。这一事实的不利一面，正如我们即将证明的，是很难预见一个给定程序在给定输入上会做什么。）

Naturally, this makes U’s simulation of T rather slow (as does the need for U to continually ‘refer back’ to the description of T in order to carry out each step of T’s computation). Nevertheless, one sees in principle why a universal Turing machine exists, and that U can simulate what T does on a given input, step by step. (Today, universal Turing machines are ubiquitous; any common programming language is equivalent to a universal Turing machine. The downside of this fact, as we are about to prove, is that it is hard to foresee what a given programme will do on a given input.)

遵循指令是一回事；预见指令将导向何处则是另一回事。例如，我们可以计算 π 的任意多位小数，但目前我们不知道是否会出现连续 1000 个 7。对图灵机而言，计算的最终结果是可证明地不确定的，正如我们可以从以下问题看出：

Now it is one thing to follow instructions; it is another to foresee where they will lead. For example, we can compute any number of decimal places of π, but at present we do not know whether 1000 consecutive 7s will ever occur. For Turing machines the ultimate outcome of computations is provably uncertain, as we can see with the following:

自我检查问题。给定图灵机 T，判定 T 以它自己的描述 des(T) 为输入时，是否终将停在一个空白方格上。

Self-examination problem. Given a Turing machine T decide whether T, with its own description des(T) as input, ever halts on a blank square.

我们这里用“问题”一词指一个无穷的问题集，在此情形下，对每台图灵机 T，问题如下：

We are using the term ‘problem’ here to mean an infinite set of questions, in this case the following, for each Turing machine T:

QT：T 在输入 des(T) 上是否终将停在一个空白方格上？

QT: Does T, on input des(T), ever halt on a blank square?

我们将证明，没有一台图灵机 S 能正确回答所有问题 QT。假定 S 以 des(T) 的形式接收问题 QT 是公平的，因为 QT 可以从 des(T) 重建。假定 S 通过停在空白方格上来回答“否”、通过停在非空白方格上来回答“是”也是公平的。

We are going to show that no Turing machine S can correctly answer all the questions QT. It is fair to assume that S receives question QT in the form des(T), because QT can be reconstructed from des(T). It is also fair to assume that S answers ‘no’ by halting on a blank square, and ‘yes’ by halting on a non-blank square.

但这样一来，S 就无法对问题 QS 给出正确答案。如果 S 在输入 QS 时停在空白方格上，那么 QS 的答案是“是”，所以 S 不应停在空白方格上。而如果 S 不停在空白方格上，那么问题 QS 的答案是“否”，于是 S 必须停在空白方格上。

But then S cannot give the correct answer to question QS. If S, given input QS, halts on a blank square, then the answer to QS is ‘yes’, so S should not halt on a blank square. And if S does not halt on a blank square then the answer to question QS is ‘no’, and S must halt on a blank square.

这一矛盾表明，自我检查问题不能由图灵机解决。因此，如果丘奇—图灵论题是正确的，这个问题就不能由任何计算解决。我们说，这个问题是算法上不可解的，或简称不可解的。

This contradiction shows that the self-examination problem cannot be solved by Turing machine. And therefore, if the Church–Turing thesis is correct, this problem cannot be solved by any computation whatever. As we say, the problem is algorithmically unsolvable or, simply, unsolvable.

由于自我检查问题相当明显地是自我挫败的，人们或许希望不可解性只是一种反常现象，而不是自然发生的事情。并非如此，因为图灵机可以被数学和逻辑中的各种自然系统所“模拟”。事实上，丘奇和图灵都立即注意到，谓词逻辑可以“模拟”图灵机，其结果是，判定谓词逻辑中有效性的问题——即所谓的判定问题（Entscheidungsproblem）——是不可解的。

Since the self-examination problem is rather obviously self-defeating, one might hope that unsolvability is an aberration, not something that happens naturally. This is not so, because Turing machines can be ‘simulated’ by various natural systems in mathematics and logic. In fact Church and Turing both noticed immediately that predicate logic can ‘simulate’ Turing machines, with the result the problem of deciding validity in predicate logic – the so-called Entscheidungsproblem – is unsolvable.

9.3 不完全性

9.3 Incompleteness

可计算性的概念似乎奇迹般地是完全的和绝对的，与之形成对比的是可证性的概念，它被证明是不完全的和相对的。二者之间的联系是不可计算性，它通过对角线论证从可计算性推出。对角线论证最方便的形式，是康托尔（1891）用来证明任何集合的子集都比元素多的那种形式。遵循波斯特，我们把这一论证应用于与图灵机相关联的集合，即所谓的可计算枚举集合。

The notion of computability, which by some miracle seems to be complete and absolute, stands in contrast to the notion of provability, which turns out to be incomplete and relative. The link between the two is non-computability, which follows from computability by the diagonal argument. The most convenient form of the diagonal argument is the one used by Cantor (1891) to prove that any set has more subsets than elements. Following Post, we apply this argument to sets associated with Turing machines, called computably enumerable sets.

如果有一台图灵机列出一个自然数集的元素，这个集合就称为可计算枚举的。列表的方式并不重要，只要任何图灵机都有一个与之关联的可计算枚举集（可能是空集），并且我们能观察到给定的机器 T 何时列出给定的数 n。我们将诉诸丘奇—图灵论题来断言：任何直观上可列出的集合都可由图灵机列出。ℕ 是可计算枚举的，它的许多子集也是，例如素数集。此外，我们可以通过按字典序列出所有图灵机的描述，来可计算地枚举它们。令 Wn 为第 n 台图灵机所列出的可计算枚举集。

A set of natural numbers is called computably enumerable if there is a Turing machine that lists its elements. The manner of making the list is not important, as long as any Turing machine has a computably enumerable set associated with it (possibly the empty set), and we can observe when a given machine T lists a given number n. We will appeal to the Church–Turing thesis to claim that any set that is intuitively listable is listable by Turing machine. ℕ is computably enumerable, and so are many of its subsets, such as the set of prime numbers. Moreover, we can computably enumerate all the Turing machine descriptions, by listing them in lexicographical order. We let Wn be the computably enumerable set listed by the nth Turing machine.

由对角线论证可知，集合

It follows by the diagonal argument that the set

D={n:n∉Wn}

不是可计算枚举的，因为它在元素 n 处与每个 Wn 都不同。（有趣的是，它的补集 ℕ−D={n:n∈Wn} 是可计算枚举的。我们可以这样列出出现在 ℕ−D 中的 n：对 k=1,2,3,…，让前 k 台图灵机运行 k 步，一旦 n 被第 n 台机器列出，就把 n 放进列表。）

is not computably enumerable, because it differs from each Wn with respect to the element n. (Interestingly, its complement ℕ−D={n:n∈Wn} is computably enumerable. We can list the n that appear in ℕ−D by allowing the first k Turing machines to run for k steps, for k=1,2,3,…, and putting n on the list if ever it is listed by the nth machine.)

现在，按照最宽泛的可能定义，一个形式系统 F 具有一个可计算枚举的定理集，所以我们可以可计算地枚举 F 中形如 n∉D 的定理。由于 D 不是可计算枚举的，这些定理（如果正确的话）并不包括形如 n∉D 的所有真陈述。这一事实指向系统 F 的某种缺陷，但我们必须弄清“如果正确的话”这一附加条件的意义。这导致了一系列越来越强的不完全性定理。

Now a formal system F, by the broadest possible definition, has a computably enumerable set of theorems, so we can computably enumerate the theorems of F that have the form n∉D. Since D is not computably enumerable, these theorems (if correct) do not include all true statements of the form n∉D. This fact points to some failure of the system F, but we have to tease out the significance of the proviso ‘if correct’. This leads to a sequence of increasingly strong incompleteness theorems.

  1. 假设 F 是一致的，并且使 F 证明“n∉Wn”的那些 n 的集合是可计算枚举集 Wm。我们还假定 F 足够强，能够模拟图灵机，因而只要 n∈Wn 为真，F 就能证明它。那么关于语句“m∉Wm”我们能说什么呢？
    如果 F 证明了“m∉Wm”，那么根据 Wm 的定义，m∈Wm。但我们已假定 F 能证明所有这样的真陈述，所以 F 也证明了“m∈Wm”，与一致性矛盾。因此 F 不证明“m∉Wm”，于是再次根据 Wm 的定义，m∉Wm。这使“m∉Wm”成为 F 未能证明的一个具体的真语句。
    注意，语句“m∉Wm”本质上是在说“我是不可证的”，因为根据 Wm 的定义，m∉Wm 意味着“m∉Wm”不可证。
  2. 通过把图灵机的运作翻译成算术——这是可能的，尽管远非显然——我们可以证明皮亚诺算术 PA（见第 8.2 节）在上述意义上是“足够强的”。因此，PA 的语言中有一个与 m∉Wm 等价的语句，从而如果 PA 是一致的，它在 PA 中就不可证。换言之，如果 PA 是一致的，那么语句“m∉Wm”在 PA 中不可证。或者等价地说，如果 PA 是一致的，那么 m∉Wm。
  3. 对 PA 中的证明作类似的“算术化”，使我们能用 PA 语言中的一个语句 Con(PA) 来表达 PA 的一致性，并由它推出 m∉Wm。所以“Con(PA)⇒m∉Wm”是 PA 的一个定理。
    由此可知 Con(PA) 在 PA 中不可证，否则肯定前件式将给出“m∉Wm”的一个证明，而我们知道“m∉Wm”在 PA 中没有证明。因此，PA 如果是一致的，就不能证明它自身的一致性（任何包含 PA 的一致系统也都不能，因为类似的论证同样适用）。
  1. Suppose that F is consistent and that the set of n for which F proves ‘n∉Wn’ is the computably enumerable set Wm. We also assume that F is strong enough to simulate Turing machines, and hence to prove n∈Wn whenever this is true. Now what can we say about the sentence ‘m∉Wm’?
    If F proves ‘m∉Wm’, then m∈Wm, by definition of Wm. But we have assumed that F can prove all such true statements, so F also proves ‘m∈Wm’, contradicting consistency. Thus F does not prove ‘m∉Wm’, so m∉Wm, by the definition of Wm again. This makes ‘m∉Wm’ a specific true sentence that F fails to prove.
    Notice that the sentence ‘m∉Wm’ essentially says ‘I am not provable’, because m∉Wm means ‘m∉Wm’ is not provable, by definition of Wm.
  2. By translating the workings of Turing machines into arithmetic – which is possible though far from obvious – we can show that Peano Arithmetic PA (see Section 8.2) is ‘strong enough’ in the above sense. Thus the language of PA has a sentence that is equivalent to m∉Wm, and hence unprovable in PA, if PA is consistent. In other words, if PA is consistent, then the sentence ‘m∉Wm’ is not provable in PA. Or, equivalently, if PA is consistent, then m∉Wm.
  3. Similar ‘arithmetization’ of proofs in PA lets us express consistency of PA by a sentence in the language of PA, Con(PA), and to deduce from it that m∉Wm. So ‘Con(PA)⇒m∉Wm’ is a theorem of PA.
    It follows that Con(PA) cannot be proved in PA, otherwise modus ponens would give a proof of ‘m∉Wm’, and we know that ‘m∉Wm’ has no proof in PA. Thus PA, if consistent, cannot prove its own consistency (and neither can any consistent system that includes PA, because a similar argument will apply).

这是一条精彩的思路——数学中最令人惊叹的思路之一。第 1 项类似于波斯特在 1920 年代发现的结果。第 2 项和第 3 项本质上就是哥德尔（1931）的第一和第二不完全性定理，不过哥德尔是以不同的方式得到第一定理的，他直接构造了一个说“我是不可证的”的语句。有趣的是，哥德尔最初是对更高层次的《数学原理》系统证明不完全性的，因为他没有意识到计算或证明可以被算术化。促使他进行算术化的是冯·诺伊曼，后者也应分享第二不完全性定理的部分功劳。在哥德尔本人宣布这一结果之前，冯·诺伊曼就已在给哥德尔的一封信中指出了一致性的不可证性。

This is a brilliant train of thought – one of the most stunning in mathematics. Item 1 resembles the results found by Post in the 1920s. Items 2 and 3 are essentially the first and second incompleteness theorems of Gödel (1931), though Gödel found the first theorem differently, by directly constructing a sentence that says ‘I am not provable’. Interestingly, Gödel first proved incompleteness for the higher-level system of Principia Mathematica because he did not realize that computation or proof could be arithmetized. He was prompted to arithmetize by von Neumann, who also deserves some credit for the second incompleteness theorem. Von Neumann pointed out unprovability of consistency in a letter to Gödel before Gödel announced the result himself.

9.4 集合论的不完全性

9.4 The Incompleteness of Set Theory

对角线论证是证明诸如皮亚诺算术等常见数学公理系统之不完全性的一种简便而有力的方法。但迄今为止，它未能证明任何著名的未证语句（例如哥德巴赫猜想、孪生素数猜想或黎曼假设）的不可证性（在 PA 或任何更强的系统中）。事实上，迄今发现的所有不可证语句，都是逻辑学家设计出来的。

The diagonal argument is an easy and powerful way to demonstrate the incompleteness of common axiom systems for mathematics such as Peano arithmetic. But it has so far failed to show the unprovability (in PA or any stronger system) of any well known unproved sentences, such as the Goldbach conjecture, twin prime conjecture, or Riemann hypothesis. In fact, all of the unprovable sentences found so far are ones devised by logicians.

集合论中的情况则不同，自康托尔时代以来悬而未决的若干命题后来被证明不能从标准的集合论公理证明。其中最有趣的两个是选择公理和连续统假设。

The situation is different in set theory, where several propositions open since Cantor’s time were subsequently shown to be unprovable from the standard set theory axioms. Two of the most interesting are the axiom of choice and the continuum hypothesis.

选择公理断言，任何由非空集合 x 构成的集合 X 都有一个选择函数：一个函数 f，使得对每个 x∈X 有 f(x)∈x。每当一个集合借助无穷多次选择来定义时，就隐含地用到了这条公理（在早期它常常被不自觉地使用）。例如，为了证明一个无穷集合 X 包含一个无穷元素序列 x1,x2,x3,…，人们想说：从 X 中选 x1，然后从 X−{x1} 中选 x2，再从 X−{x1,x2} 中选 x3，依此类推。但即使是这个简单的定义，也无法由标准的集合论公理得到辩护。科恩（1963a，b）通过构造标准公理的一个模型证明了这一点，在该模型中存在一个不包含无穷序列的无穷集合（由实数构成）。

The axiom of choice states that any set X of non-empty sets x has a choice function: a function f such that f(x)∈x for each x∈X. This axiom is used implicitly (and in the early days it was often used unconsciously) whenever a set is defined by means of an infinite sequence of choices. For example, to prove that an infinite set X contains an infinite sequence of elements x1,x2,x3,… one wants to say: choose x1 from X, then x2 from X−{x1}, then x3 from X−{x1,x2}, and so on. But even this simple definition cannot be justified by the standard axioms of set theory. Cohen (1963a,b) showed this by constructing a model of the standard axioms in which there is an infinite set (of real numbers) containing no infinite sequence.

连续统假设源于康托尔关于 ℝ 是比 ℕ 大的集合的发现。在其朴素形式中，这一假设断言 ℝ 是 ℕ 之后的下一个最大集合。（康托尔还给出了一个涉及序数的更精致的形式，我在此没有篇幅解释。）科恩（1963a，b）通过构造标准公理的一个使该假设为假的模型，证明了连续统假设不能从标准公理证明。还应当提到，选择公理和连续统假设也不能从标准公理否证。这是哥德尔（1938）在构造了一个两个陈述都成立的模型时证明的。

The continuum hypothesis arose from Cantor’s discovery that ℝ is a set larger than ℕ. In its naive form, the hypothesis states that ℝ is the next largest set after ℕ. (Cantor also gave a more sophisticated form, involving ordinal numbers, that I do not have space to explain here.) Cohen (1963a,b) showed that the continuum hypothesis is not provable from the standard axioms, by constructing a model of these axioms in which the hypothesis is false. It should also be mentioned that the axiom of choice and the continuum hypothesis cannot be disproved from the standard axioms. This was shown by Gödel (1938) when he constructed a model in which both statements hold.

因此，关于无穷集合的两个最自然的问题，不能由自然的公理来解决。这种情况有点像平行公理相对于欧几里得（或希尔伯特）其他公理的情况。只要其他公理是一致的，我们可以自由地加入其中任一公理或它的否定，而不会产生矛盾。不同之处在于，就我们所知，对集合论来说，没有明显自然的备择模型——没有“康托尔式”和“非康托尔式”的集合论。2

Thus two of the most natural questions about infinite sets cannot be settled by the natural axioms. The situation is a little like the situation of the parallel axiom relative to the other axioms of Euclid (or Hilbert). We are free to add either axiom or its negation and no contradiction will arise, assuming that the other axioms are consistent. The difference is that, as far as we know, for set theory there are no obviously natural models for the alternatives – no ‘Cantorian’ and ‘non-Cantorian’ set theories.2

2 也许更好的说法是：“康托尔式”和“非康托尔式”集合论的已知模型，都只是为了给这些理论建模而专门构造的。这与几何中的情况形成对比，在几何中，人们发现非欧几何在某些结构中成立，而这些结构在有合适的几何语言描述它们之前就已被研究过。我们在第 6.3 节提到过这一点。
2 Perhaps it would be better to say that the only known models for ‘Cantorian’ and ‘non-Cantorian’ set theories are those constructed with the purpose of modelling these theories. This contrasts with the situation in geometry, where non-Euclidean geometry was found to hold in certain structures that had been studied before there was a suitable geometric language to describe them. We mentioned this in section 6.3.

9.5 哲学问题

9.5 Philosophical Issues

考虑到从 1930 年代到 1960 年代的发展，我们可以看到数学哲学自古希腊以来已经演变了多远：

Taking the developments from the 1930s to the 1960s into account, we can see how far the philosophy of mathematics has evolved since ancient Greece:

  1. 希腊人未曾认识到的可计算性概念，已被精确地定义，并在数学的广大领域中占据支配地位。它为证明的概念设定了界限，并裁定许多问题是否可解。
  2. 逻辑中的证明概念已被完全刻画（就与数学最相关的谓词逻辑而言）：存在一个生成所有逻辑有效公式的计算。然而，不存在一个算法，能对任意给定的公式判定该公式是否可证（因而是否有效）。
  3. 数学中的证明概念是不完全的，因而达不到绝对的数学真理；事实上，对任何包含一定量算术的一致系统 F，都存在 F 的不能由 F 证明的真陈述。从好的一面看，由逻辑的完全性可知，我们能找到给定公理集的所有推论。
  4. 希尔伯特关于数学存在就是一致性的主张已被发现是站得住的，因为哥德尔对谓词逻辑完全性的证明为任何一致的公理集给出了一个模型（如第 8.3 节所述）。然而，一个可计算的公理集不一定有可计算的模型，所以这种存在不为构造主义者所接受。
  5. 数学的一致性必须是一个直觉问题；这是指任何相当强的（且一致的）系统都不包含它自身一致性的证明。这一结果似乎使希尔伯特证明一致性的纲领受到了无法修复的损害。
  6. 无穷的意义与存在已成为一个更复杂的问题。大多数数学家所接受的连续统，只能作为实无穷来把握，因为它是不可数的。但实无穷有无穷多个。在实无穷中，可接受与不可接受之间的界线应划在何处，尚不清楚。
  7. 尽管有种种困难，连续统已成为分析的基础，因而也成为大部分几何和大部分数学物理的基础。这些数学领域已被算术化；即建立在自然数公理加上某些关于无穷集合的公理之上。
  8. 连续统仍未被完全理解，因为连续统假设不能由标准的集合论公理来解决。另一方面，也没有找到一个为大多数数学家所接受的连续统的“构造性”类似物。
  1. The concept of computability, unrecognized by the Greeks, has been precisely defined and now rules large areas of mathematics. It sets the limits for the concept of proof, and adjudicates whether many problems are solvable or not.
  2. The concept of proof in logic has been described completely (in the case of predicate logic, the one most relevant to mathematics): there is a computation that generates all logically valid formulas. However, there is no algorithm that decides, given an arbitrary formula, whether that formula is provable (hence valid) or not.
  3. The concept of proof in mathematics is incomplete, and hence falls short of absolute mathematical truth; in fact, for any consistent system F containing a certain amount of arithmetic there are true statements of F not provable by F. On the bright side, it follows from the completeness of logic that we can find all consequences of a given set of axioms.
  4. A claim of Hilbert, that mathematical existence is the same as consistency, has been found tenable, since Gödel’s proof of the completeness of predicate logic gives a model for any consistent set of axioms (as mentioned in Section 8.3). However, a computable set of axioms need not have a computable model, so this kind of existence is not acceptable to constructivists.
  5. The consistency of mathematics has to be a matter of intuition; in the sense that any reasonably strong (and consistent) system contains no proof of its own consistency. The Hilbert program for proving consistency seems damaged beyond repair by this result.
  6. The meaning and existence of infinity has become a more complicated question. The continuum, which most mathematicians accept, can be grasped only as an actual infinity, because it is uncountable. But there are infinitely many actual infinities. It is unclear where to draw the line between acceptable and unacceptable in the actual infinities.
  7. Despite its difficulties, the continuum has become the basis for analysis, hence most of geometry, and most of mathematical physics. These fields of mathematics have been arithmetized; that is, based on axioms for the natural numbers plus certain axioms for infinite sets.
  8. The continuum is still not completely understood, since the continuum hypothesis is not settled by the standard axioms of set theory. On the other hand, no ‘constructive’ analogue of the continuum has been found that is acceptable to the majority of mathematicians.
（注：第 4 项原文作“as mentioned in Section 8.3”，相关内容实际见于第 8.5 节；英文保留原文。）
